name: Handloom Rebate Scheme
brief_description: The scheme provides 10% special rebate for 120 festival days; Additional 5-15% permanent rebates for regular sales; Enhanced 20% rebates for women-led cooperatives. The scheme aims to enhance market competitiveness for Gujarat's handloom cooperatives and apex societies.
details: The "Handloom Rebate Scheme" by the Commissioner of Cottage and Rural Industries, Government of Gujarat, provides financial rebates to boost sales of handloom products during festivals. It offers 10% special rebate for 120 festival days; Additional 5-15% permanent rebates for regular sales; Enhanced 20% rebates for women-led cooperatives. The scheme aims to enhance market competitiveness for Gujarat's handloom cooperatives and apex societies while directly benefiting artisans.
benefits:
**Festival Rebate:** 10% on sales for 120 days; 20% for women-led cooperatives.
**Permanent Rebates:** 5% standard; 15% for women-led groups.
**Additional Support:** e-Voucher toolkit distribution; Priority for SC/ST/BPL artisans.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a registered cooperative society, apex institution, or women-led group.
- The applicant must produce handloom products.
- The applicant must obtain prior rebate certification from the Commissionerate.

application_process.steps:
**Steps for New Registration**
**Step 1:** Visit the [eKutir portal](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in). In the right pane of the landing page, click "[For New Individual Registration, click Here](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in/Registration.aspx)".
**Step 2:** On the registration page, fill in all mandatory fields (marked with an asterisk): Full Name (in English), Aadhaar Card Number, Gender, Date of Birth, Mobile Number, E-mail, Password (confirm the password by typing it again). Fill in the Captcha Code, and click "Register".
**Step 3:** A confirmation pop-up will display the entered name, mobile number, and other details. If all the details are correct, click "Confirm" to proceed. If any information is incorrect, click "Cancel", make the necessary corrections, and then click "Register" again.
**Step 4:** Upon successful registration, the User ID and Password will be sent to your registered mobile number via SMS. If an email address has been provided, the credentials will also be sent via email.

**Steps for Login Procedure and User Profile Update**
**Step 1:** Visit the [eKutir portal](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in). In the right pane of the landing page (in the "Login to Portal" section), provide your User ID, Password, and the Captcha Code. Then click "Login".
**Step 2:** Upon first login, the user must complete the "User Profile" by providing personal and organisational details. All fields marked with an asterisk are mandatory. Some fields will already be pre-filled based on the information provided during registration.
_*Most of these details can later be updated from the “View Profile” section, except for the fields initially filled during registration._

**Steps for Scheme Application**
**Step 1:** After logging in and completing the profile, the system displays schemes relevant to the user on the homepage. Click on the name of the scheme that you intend to apply for. You will be redirected to the online application form of the scheme. The application form is divided into multiple tabs. 
**Step 2:** In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. For each uploaded document, the corresponding document number must be entered wherever required. Click the “Save & Next” button to proceed to the subsequent tabs. 
**Step 3:** Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections. Acknowledge and agree to the terms and conditions, declaration, and privacy policy (if any) by ticking the designated checkbox.
**Step 4:** Clicking “Save & Next” in the last tab of the application form generates an application number, which is displayed on the screen. The applicant must record this number for future reference. If the applicant wishes to print the application, they may click the “Print Application” button.
_*If you do not wish to continue with the application at that point, you may click "Cancel"._

**Application Printing and Modification**

- If the user wishes to print the application, they may click “Print Application.” 
- If the application has been returned for revision, a “Modify” button will appear. The user can then edit the application and resubmit it.

**Helpdesk/Grievance Redressal**

- Call 9909926280 / 9909926180.
- Connect with the [District Industries Centre (DIC)](https://www.cottage.gujarat.gov.in/Home-2140795B5D2D-282472282472-2824725B5D2D) of your district.

**Check Application Status**
Visit the [Application Status](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in/ViewApplicationStatus.aspx) page Provide the Application Number of the scheme, and your Date of Birth. Then click "View Status".

documents_required: Sales Invoices (Festival Period for Special Rebate).

name: Reimbursement of Tuition Fees for Typewriting and Shorthand Courses for Children of Widows
nodal_department: Women and Child Development Department, Puducherry
brief_description: “Reimbursement of Tuition Fees for Typewriting and Shorthand Courses for Children of Widows” by the Dept of Women & Child Development, Govt of Pondicherry, was introduced to encourage the children of widows to pursue Typewriting and Shorthand courses and facilitate the reimbursement of course fees.
details: The scheme “Reimbursement of Tuition Fees for Typewriting and Shorthand Courses for Children of Widows” by the Department of Women & Child Development, Government of Pondicherry, was introduced to encourage the children of widows to pursue Typewriting and Shorthand courses and facilitate the reimbursement of the course fees.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance of ₹ 50/- per month, as a reimbursement of the tuition fees.**
*The reimbursement shall be allowed only for a maximum period of ten months for a course and for the first attempt only.
*The reimbursement shall be allowed only for any two children of the widow.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be a native of the Union Territory of Pondicherry by birth or continuous residence for not less than 5 years.
- The applicant should be a widow.
- The annual income of the applicant should not exceed ₹24,000.
- The child of the widow should be a Student.
- The child of the widow should be enrolled in an approved recognised by the Government of Tamilnadu/Government of Kerala/Government of Andhra Pradesh for the purpose of technical examinations.
- The child should have passed/appeared for SSLC/Matriculation or any other equivalent examination recognized by the Education Department, Puducherry.
- The child of the widow should be studying typewriting and/or shorthand.
- Upto two dependent children of a widow are eligible.
- The widow should not have been receiving assistance/grant under any other scheme being implemented by the Social Welfare Department, Puducherry.

application_process.steps:
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the [Office/ Sub-Office](https://wcd.py.gov.in/office-locations) of the Department of Women and Child Development, and request the hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
OR
The interested applicant should take print of the prescribed format of the application form.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Deputy Director (Women Development) or the Child Development Project Officer (depending on the location), at least 30 days before the proposed marriage date.

name: Chief Minister’s Shasakt Kisan Yojana
department: District Agriculture Office
brief_description: The Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh started the scheme “Chief Minister’s Shasakt Kisan Yojana (CM-SKY)” for uplifting the status of women, marginal and small farmers of the State for self-employment generation & commercialization of Horticulture activities to double their income.
details:
To increase production and productivity and also to maintain a marketable surplus of major fruit crops in the State as well as to double farmer’s income, the government has adopted region-wise feasible and need-based Horticulture activities in the various districts of Arunachal Pradesh under budget announcement during the financial year 2019-20, targeted up to 2021-22.
**Objective:**
 The main aim of the government scheme is to uplift the status of women, marginal and small farmers of the state for self-employment generation & commercialization of horticulture activities to double their income as per immediate felt needs of the farmers, according to thrust areas enumerated district-wise on suitable crops grown in the specific areas.
**Important Features:**
• Inputs are provided to farmers for tea, rubber, and double cropping, per hectare
• Crops under double cropping are selected based on soil testing
eligibility:
1. The applicant/farmer should be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh.
2. The applicant should be a progressive farmer of any area/field.
3. All categories of farmers are eligible to apply under the scheme.

name: Free Pre-Recruitment Training
department: State Sainik Board, Government Of Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide 8 weeks of free pre-recruitment training for recruitment into the Military, Paramilitary, and Police Forces to sons of ex-servicemen aged between 16 and 21 years who have passed high school with at least 45% marks.
details: The scheme "Free Pre-Recruitment Training" is implemented by the State Sainik Board under the Sainik Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide 8 weeks of free pre-recruitment training for the Military, Paramilitary, and Police forces to the sons of ex-servicemen aged between 16 and 21 years.
benefits: Under this scheme, 8 weeks of free pre-recruitment training for recruitment into the Military, Paramilitary, and Police Forces is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a son of an ex-serviceman.
1. The applicant's age should be more than 16 years and less than 21 years.
1. The applicant should have passed high school with 45% marks.

***All expenses incurred on training (honorarium of trainers + food + accommodation) are borne by the Directorate of Sainik Welfare.***
**Note: 5** courses are conducted each year.

application_process.steps:
- The District Sainik Welfare Office invites applications from sons of ex-servicemen through public notifications. 
 - Applicants are required to submit the following documents: Ordinary Application Form, Birth Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Educational Certificate (at least High School or Higher Secondary), Medical Certificate, Ex-Serviceman Identity Card, and Discharge Book. 
 - The above documents should be submitted to the concerned District Sainik Welfare Office. Once the applications are processed, selected trainees are informed about the training schedule, after which the training is conducted in the Garhwal and Kumaon divisions of the state.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for this training?
faqs.answer: Sons of ex-servicemen aged 16 to 21 years who have passed High School with at least 45% marks are eligible.

faqs.answer: The training program lasts for 8 weeks.

faqs.answer: The training prepares candidates for recruitment into Military, Paramilitary, and Police forces, including physical fitness, general knowledge, and written exam preparation.

faqs.answer: No. The training is completely free, and all expenses (honorarium of trainers, food, and accommodation) are borne by the Directorate of Sainik Welfare.

faqs.question: How many courses are conducted each year?
faqs.answer: A total of 5 courses are conducted annually.

faqs.question: Where is the training conducted?
faqs.answer: Training is conducted in the Garhwal and Kumaon divisions of Uttarakhand.

faqs.question: How can eligible candidates apply?
faqs.answer: Applications are invited by the District Sainik Welfare Office through public notifications. Candidates must submit their application along with required documents.

faqs.answer: Yes, participating trainees are informed by the District Sainik Welfare Office before the training begins.

faqs.question: What expenses are covered under the scheme?
faqs.answer: All training-related expenses including honorarium of trainers, food, and accommodation are provided by the scheme.

faqs.answer: Yes, candidates must have passed High School with at least 45% marks.

department: Sports Authority Of India (SA1)
brief_description: The MAKA Trophy instituted in year 1956-57 is a rolling trophy awarded by the Ministry of Sports to the overall top performing University in sports of the preceding year for promoting competitive sports in the university sector with a view to arouse keen interest among students.
benefits:
> **Top 3 (three) recognized Universities on the basis of overall marks secured will be awarded. The amount of cash prizes is mentioned below respectively:**

**2nd position:** ₹7,50,000/- (Rupees Seven Lakh Fifty Thousand Only) 
**3rd position:** ₹4,50,000/- (Rupees Four Lakh Fifty Thousand Only)

**Note:** The cash award money received by the winning Universities under the Scheme should be spent for promotion of sports including opening of Centre of Excellence, creation/upgradation of infrastructure, training of athletes, cash award to sportspersons, etc.
eligibility:

Universities recognized by Government/UGC are only eligible for nomination under this scheme.

faqs.question: If I am a female construction worker who has been working for 8 months in Bihar, would I be eligible to receive maternity benefits from the state welfare board?
faqs.answer: No, you would not be eligible at this time. The scheme requires female construction workers to complete at least one year of membership with the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board before they can receive benefits.

faqs.question: As a registered female construction worker in Bihar, what is the maximum number of times I can receive maternity benefits through this welfare scheme?
faqs.answer: You can receive maternity benefits for your first two childbirths only. The benefit amount for each eligible childbirth will be equivalent to 90 days of the state-mandated minimum wages for unskilled workers.

faqs.question: What steps do I need to take to register myself as a construction worker before I can apply for maternity benefits in Bihar?
faqs.answer: You need to visit the official website of the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, click on "Apply for New Registration", provide your Aadhaar Number for authentication, fill in all mandatory fields marked with asterisk (*), and pay the application fee online to receive your registration number.

faqs.question: Could you explain the complete process of applying for maternity benefits after I have received my construction worker registration number?
faqs.answer: Visit the official website, click on "Scheme Application", select "Apply for Scheme", enter your registration number to view your details, select the maternity benefits scheme, fill in all mandatory information, upload required documents in the specified format and size, and click "Submit Application".

faqs.question: If I register as a construction worker today, when will I become eligible to apply for maternity benefits under this scheme?
faqs.answer: You will become eligible to apply exactly one year after your registration date, provided your membership remains active throughout this period and it is either your first or second childbirth.

faqs.question: What is the exact financial assistance I will receive as maternity benefits under this welfare scheme?
faqs.answer: You will receive an amount equivalent to 90 days of the current minimum wages that are set by the Bihar State Government for unskilled workers at the time of your childbirth.

faqs.question: As a registered construction worker, what should I do to ensure my membership remains active so I can claim maternity benefits when needed?
faqs.answer: Your membership must remain active at the time of application, though the provided information doesn't specify the exact requirements for maintaining active membership status. It would be best to contact the welfare board directly for these details.

faqs.question: If I am currently pregnant and planning to register as a construction worker, will I be eligible for maternity benefits immediately after completing one year of membership?
faqs.answer: Yes, once you complete one year of membership with the Board, you will be eligible for maternity benefits provided this is either your first or second childbirth and your membership remains active.

name: Bhagyalaxmi Scheme
brief_description: The prime goal of this scheme aims to promote the birth of girl children in below poverty line(BPL) families and to raise the status of the girl child in the family in particular and society in general. Financial assistance is provided to the girl child through her mother/father or natural guardian.
details:
**Detail**
The Karnataka state government will give female children financial aid under the Karnataka Bhagya Lakshmi Scheme. The payment of this support is to be made through the mother, father, or legal guardian provided that all requirements are met. 

**The objective of this scheme**

- To promote the birth of girl children among families identified as below the poverty line.
- To increase the status of girl child thereby raising the status of the society.
- To Promote the birth of girl child in economically weaker families and to raise their status within the family and society.
- To provide Financial assistance to the girl child through her mother/father/natural guardian subject to the fulfilment of certain conditions
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. A girl’s birth must be registered within a year after her birth date.
1. Girls shouldn’t engage in child labour.
1. Benefits from the Bhagyalakshmi scheme are available to BPL families with up to 2 female children.
1. Girls should have been immunized correctly in the health department’s program.
1. Girl children must be born after 31 March 2006 in a BPL family.
1. A girl must have completed the eighth grade to be eligible for the maturity amount
1. She cannot have been married off before turning 18 years old.

name: Mobility Scheme
department: Department Of Science & Technology, Govt. Of India
brief_description: The Mobility Scheme is aimed to provide an opportunity to women scientists who are facing difficulties in their present job due to relocation (marriage, transfer of husband to any other location within the country, attending ailing parents, and accompanying children studying in different city).
details:
The “Mobility Scheme” was launched under Knowledge Involvement in Research Advancement through Nurturing (KIRAN) Programme by the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India, aims to address relocation issue of women scientists working in regular position in Government Organizations. The scheme aims to provide an opportunity to women scientists who are facing difficulties in their present job due to relocation (marriage, transfer of husband to any other location within the country, attending ailing parents, and accompanying children studying in different city) and will act as filler while searching other career option at new place.
The initiative intends to provide a harmonious environment during early phases of women scientists where they would like to stay active in research in addition to attending and fulfilling other responsibilities in the domestic front. It offers a contractual research award to women scientists and enables them for independent research.
benefits: - **Monthly Salary:** Consolidated monthly salary is provided to awardees for the entire project duration. - **Manpower Support:** Need-based manpower support is provided to assist in project implementation. - **Research Grant:** ₹5,00,000/- per annum is provided for consumables, contingencies, travel, and minor equipment. - ***Duration:*** Total tenure will be a maximum of five (5) years for this award. This award will not be available for renewal after completion of 5 years duration.
eligibility:
- Woman scientists/academicians working at permanent position in any Government Institution/R&D Lab/University and willing to resign from their permanent position or take a long leave to avail the fellowship and after completion of the tenure return back to the parent organization.
 - The new place should be located beyond 500 Km from present city.
 - Upper age limit is 50 years to apply.

application_process.steps:
**Step 1:** The applicant needs to prepare a full-fledged research proposal in the area of her expertise.
**Step 2:** Five copies of application form including general information and research proposal is to be submitted in prescribed format available at [https://dst.gov.in](https://dst.gov.in/).
**Step3:** Five (5) copies of application should be sent to Department of Science and Technology, Technology Bhawan, New Mehrauli Road, New Delhi-110016 by speed post.
> **Note:** The envelope may be superscribed with "Mobility Scheme”.

faqs.question: What is the aim of this Scheme?
faqs.answer: The Mobility Scheme is an initiative aimed at providing opportunities to women scientists who face job-related challenges due to relocation.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for the scheme?
faqs.answer: Women scientists or academicians holding permanent positions in Government Institutions, R&D Labs, or Universities, who are willing to resign or take long leave to avail the fellowship, are eligible.

faqs.question: What circumstances qualify as reasons for relocation under this scheme?
faqs.answer: Qualifying circumstances include relocation due to marriage, transfer of a spouse to another location within the country, attending to ailing parents, or accompanying children studying in a different city.

faqs.question: What is the duration of the fellowship under the Scheme?
faqs.answer: The total tenure of the award is a maximum of five years.

faqs.question: What financial support is provided to the awardees?
faqs.answer: Awardees receive a consolidated monthly salary for the project duration. Additionally, there is a research grant of [?]5 lakh per annum, which includes provisions for consumables, contingencies, travel, and minor equipment necessary for implementing the project.

faqs.question: Is there support for hiring manpower under this scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes, the scheme provides need-based support for hiring one manpower personnel to assist in the research project.

faqs.question: Can the awardee return to their parent organization after the fellowship?
faqs.answer: Yes, awardees have the option to return to their parent organization after completing the tenure of the fellowship.

faqs.question: Are there any restrictions on the location of the new workplace?
faqs.answer: Yes, the new workplace must be located more than 500 km away from the applicant's current city.

faqs.question: What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faqs.answer: Applicants must be under the age of 50 to be eligible for the scheme.

faqs.question: How can one apply for the Mobility Scheme?
faqs.answer: Applicants need to prepare a detailed research proposal in their area of expertise. Five copies of the application form, including general information and the research proposal in the prescribed format, should be submitted.

faqs.question: Where can applicants find the application format?
faqs.answer: The prescribed application format is available on the Department of Science & Technology's official website.

faqs.question: To whom should the application be sent?
faqs.answer: Five copies of the application should be sent to Department of Science & Technology, Technology Bhawan, New Mehrauli Road, New Delhi-110016, by speed post.

faqs.question: Is the scheme applicable to women scientists in private institutions?
faqs.answer: No, the scheme is specifically designed for women scientists working in permanent positions in Government Institutions, R&D Labs, or Universities.

details:
The scheme “ Scheme For Vaccine Manufacturing Units” is a sub scheme under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)- 2022” for Thrust Sectors. It was launched on 07th May 2022 for a period of five years by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu. 
> **Objective of the "Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)- 2022”:**

 - The scheme envisages to provide incentives and assistance to the MSME Sector in order to nurture them and protect them from market vagaries thereby making them vibrant and successful. 
 - The Scheme intends to provide impetus for the identified Thrust sectors such as Furniture, Marble, IT & ITeS , Electric Vehicles & Spare Parts, Toys and Semi-Conductor Industries Sector, Medical Equipment and Accessories, Medical diagnostics and AYUSH Products, Vaccine Manufacturing units, Food Processing, Marine Products thereby making the U.T as a hub of manufacturing of these Products. 

 - To double the value of Export of the Processed Products as well as to make the U.T, a center for these identified export products. 
 - To incentivize industry to take up environment protection measures for judicious use of scarce resources and as well as to ensure inter generational equity. 
 - To reduce unemployment among the local residents and incentivize the industries to employ resident laborers. 
 - To maximize Women participation in the business sector by providing incentives. 
 - To encourage first generation Entrepreneurs and support them in their entrepreneurial endeavor. 
 - To hone the Entrepreneurship skills of the youth of the Territory and create a skillful workforce. 
 - To provide further fillip to the specialized Textile sector such as Technical textiles, Fabrics, Carpets, Garments, Apparels and Industries Manufacturing Textile Machinery, Medical Fabrics, therefore making the U.T. a Special Hub for Technical Textiles.
 - To promote innovation in Industrial sector by encouraging industry to involve themselves in Research & Development (R&D) works and to obtain Patents both, National and International Level. 

**Objective of the " Scheme For Vaccine Manufacturing Units" Sub-scheme:**
Under this scheme, Credit-Linked Interest Subsidy and Capital Subsidy shall be provided to Vaccine Manufacturing Units.
benefits: Credit Linked Interest Subsidy for Vaccine Manufacturing Units @ 70% of interest charged by Bank with upper ceiling up to Rs.60 Lakhs per annum for 5 years OR for the period of repayment of loan whichever is earlier and Capital investment Subsidy @ 15% of the investment upto a maximum of 10 crores.
exclusions: - The Enterprise will not be eligible for Interest Subsidy under this Scheme if, term loan is sanctioned after one year from the date of commencement of commercial production.
eligibility:
1. The Scheme is applicable to New Enterprises and Existing Enterprises who had started commercial production during the operative period of the Scheme. 
 1. Only Gross Fixed Capital Investment (GFCI) made in New Building, New Plant & Machinery / Equipment and Machineries excluding land will be eligible for incentives for manufacturing. 
 1. Enterprise shall have to furnish information regarding production, sales, turnover, and employment etc. annually to concerned DIC before end of September each year. 
 1. Enterprise will have to observe pollution Control measures as prescribed by PCC or other competent authority. 
 1. Enterprise will have to remain in production for 5 years from the date of commercial production and if it fails to continue production for 5 years, the amount of Capital Investment Subsidy disbursed will be recovered as arrears of land revenue. 
 1. Out of Diversification and Expansion, only one activity once will be eligible for subsidy during the policy period. 
 1. Existing or New Enterprise carrying out an activity of Expansion or Diversification with an investment more than 50% (out of which minimum 60% investment should be in Plant & machinery) of GFCI will be eligible. 
 1. The Enterprise shall furnish Chartered Accountant certified bills. 
 1. Loan Sanctioned by Bank or Financial Institution as per RBI guidelines for the industry located in U.T. will be eligible for subsidy under this Scheme. 
 1. The Enterprise will not be eligible for Interest Subsidy under this Scheme if, term loan is sanctioned after one year from the date of commencement of commercial production. 
 1. Enterprise shall have to apply at online portal within one year from the date of first disbursement of loan or on or before the date of commencement of commercial production, whichever is later. 
 1. Interest subsidy will be eligible either from the date of first disbursement of loan or from the date of commencement of commercial production whichever is later. 
 1. Reimbursement of interest subsidy will be made only after commencement of commercial production of the enterprise. 
 1. If the Enterprise becomes defaulter in payment of interest or instalment of term loan to Bank/Financial institution as per guidelines of RBI and as mentioned in certificate of Bank/Financial institution such default period will be deducted. 
 1. The interest subsidy will be available only on interest levied by the financial institution/banks. 
 1. Interest Subsidy will not be available for penal interest or any other bank charges. 
 1. The eligible Enterprise shall have to bear a minimum of 2% interest levied on term loan by any Bank / Financial institution. The Enterprise shall submit details and undertaking in this regard. 
 1. The interest subsidy will be directly credited to Bank / Financial institution.

faqs.question: What type of investments are eligible for incentives under this policy?
faqs.answer: Only Gross Fixed Capital Investment (GFCI) made in new buildings, new plant & machinery, equipment, and machineries (excluding land) are eligible for incentives for manufacturing.

faqs.question: What information must enterprises provide annually?
faqs.answer: Enterprises must furnish information regarding production, sales, turnover, and employment, etc., to the concerned District Industries Centre (DIC) before the end of September each year.

faqs.question: What pollution control measures must enterprises follow?
faqs.answer: Enterprises must observe pollution control measures as prescribed by the Pollution Control Committee (PCC) or other competent authorities.

faqs.question: How long must an enterprise remain in production to retain the Capital Investment Subsidy?
faqs.answer: Enterprises must remain in production for 5 years from the date of commercial production. If an enterprise fails to continue production for 5 years, the amount of the Capital Investment Subsidy disbursed will be recovered as arrears of land revenue.

faqs.question: Are both diversification and expansion activities eligible for subsidy?
faqs.answer: Out of diversification and expansion, only one activity will be eligible for subsidy once during the policy period.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria for an enterprise undertaking expansion or diversification?
faqs.answer: An existing or new enterprise carrying out an activity of expansion or diversification with an investment more than 50% of the GFCI (with at least 60% of this investment in plant & machinery) will be eligible.

faqs.question: What additional documentation is required for claiming the subsidy?
faqs.answer: Enterprises must furnish Chartered Accountant certified bills to claim the subsidy.

faqs.question: Are loans sanctioned by banks or financial institutions eligible for subsidy?
faqs.answer: Yes, loans sanctioned by banks or financial institutions in accordance with RBI guidelines for industries located in U.T. are eligible for subsidy under this scheme.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for Interest Subsidy under this Scheme?
faqs.answer: The Enterprise will not be eligible for Interest Subsidy if the term loan is sanctioned after one year from the date of commencement of commercial production.

faqs.question: When does the Interest Subsidy become effective?
faqs.answer: Interest subsidy will be eligible either from the date of the first disbursement of the loan or from the date of commencement of commercial production, whichever is later. However, reimbursement of interest subsidy shall be made only after the commencement of commercial production of the enterprise.

faqs.question: What happens if the Enterprise defaults on payment?
faqs.answer: If the Enterprise becomes a defaulter in the payment of interest or installment of term loan to the Bank/Financial institution as per the guidelines of RBI and as mentioned in the certificate of the Bank/Financial institution, such default period will be deducted.

faqs.question: What is the scope of the interest subsidy?
faqs.answer: The interest subsidy is applicable solely to the interest charged by financial institutions or banks on loans.

faqs.question: Are penal interest and other bank charges covered under the subsidy?
faqs.answer: No, penal interest and other bank charges are not eligible for the interest subsidy.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum interest rate requirement for eligibility?
faqs.answer: Yes, the eligible enterprise must bear a minimum of 2% interest on term loans provided by any bank or financial institution.

faqs.question: How can an enterprise demonstrate compliance with the minimum interest requirement?
faqs.answer: The enterprise is required to submit details and an undertaking confirming their compliance with the minimum interest requirement.

faqs.question: How is the interest subsidy disbursed?
faqs.answer: The interest subsidy is directly credited to the respective bank or financial institution that provided the loan.

faqs.question: What happens to the benefit of the incentive if a newly setup enterprise is sold or transferred to a new owner within the first five years of its establishment?
faqs.answer: If a newly setup enterprise is sold or otherwise transferred to a new owner during the period of five years, the benefit of the incentive shall be available to such transferee or the new owner, only for the unexpired portion.

faqs.question: What is the definition of Expansion/ Diversification?
faqs.answer: Expansion/Diversification means where an existing / New Enterprise increases its investment by at least 50% (out of which at least 60% of investment is made in plant and machinery for which expansion is carried out) of its existing Gross Fixed capital investment on the date of initiating expansion and compared with the date of commencing production during the operative period of the scheme. Only one Expansion / Diversification will be eligible for assistance during the operative period of the Scheme.

faqs.question: What measures are in place to prevent misuse of the subsidy scheme?
faqs.answer: Strict guidelines, documentation requirements, and verification procedures are in place to ensure that subsidies are availed by eligible enterprises for genuine purposes only.

faqs.question: What is the operative period of the scheme?
faqs.answer: The operative period of scheme is from 20.05.2022 till 5 years that is 19.05.2027.

faqs.question: If an enterprise is established in 2023 and becomes eligible for the scheme what would be the time period in which benefits are applicable?
faqs.answer: The enterprise can avail benefit commencing from date of production till 5 years even if that period falls beyond operative period.

faqs.question: How can an eligible unit apply to get the benefits of the scheme?
faqs.answer: The eligible unit can apply by visiting single window portal website which is "swp.dddgov.in", and once page pops-up the user have to go to departments tab and select district industries tab under which the user have to click on apply for investment promotion scheme: 2022 to 2027.

name: Documentation And Research Assistantship Scheme
brief_description: The scheme aims to encourage documentation and digitisation of valuable Tiatr-related materials to prevent their loss to posterity. It provides assistance and incentives to holders of such materials and pays honorarium to documentation assistants.
details: The scheme "Documentation And Research Assistantship Scheme" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage documentation and digitisation of valuable Tiatr-related materials such as manuscripts, photos, handbills, advertisements, newspaper or magazine clippings, video and audio recordings that are with Tiatr artistes, tiatr lovers and institutions, addressing the high degree of risk that some of these materials may be lost to posterity if efforts are not undertaken to preserve and document them. The scheme provides assistance to possessors of Tiatr-related materials to organize and document their holdings.
benefits:
- One-time Incentive: A reasonable amount as decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa will be paid to the holder for converting materials into electronic formats.
- Hourly Honorarium: Documentation assistants will be paid an honorarium on clock-hour basis as determined by Tiatr Academy of Goa.
- Reimbursement: Tiatr Academy of Goa will reimburse costs incurred towards conversion according to rates determined by it if services of other agencies become necessary.
- Assistance provided to organize and document materials in holdings.
- Copy of digitised material provided to the holder on Digital Versatile Disc or Pen-drive.
- Professional documentation and preservation services.

> ***Conditions***

_*The work done must be certified by the holder of the material._
_*Tiatr Academy of Goa will periodically review the work undertaken and accordingly extend or curtail the assistantship._
_*Holders must indicate willingness to permit and facilitate documentation tasks._
eligibility:
> ***For Material Holders***

- The applicant must be a possessor of materials related to Tiatr such as manuscripts, photos, handbills, advertisements, newspaper or magazine clippings, video and audio recordings.
- The applicant must indicate willingness to permit and facilitate documentation and organization tasks.

> ***For Documentation Assistants***

- The applicant must be willing to serve as Documentation Assistant.
- The applicant must be capable of performing tasks including compilation and organisation of materials, typing or word-processing of textual materials, scanning and converting by Optical Character Recognition, conversion of images by scanning or photographing with digital camera, and converting video or audio recordings from analogue to digital format.

application_process.steps:
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. The form requires details including name of artiste or documentation assistant, complete address, contact number, email identification, Aadhaar Card number, and specific aspect of Tiatr on which documentation can be done.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields including personal details, contact information, and specify the aspect of Tiatr on which documentation work can be undertaken. Attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date.
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - 
**Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001**
_*For material holders, indicate willingness to permit and facilitate documentation tasks, and may also indicate proximate candidates willing to undertake the documentation work._
_*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment received for future reference._

##### ***Post-Application Processes***
**Step 1:****** ***Assignment of Tasks***
Tiatr Academy of Goa will assign documentation tasks to candidates according to the requests received from the holders of materials. The academy will match documentation assistants with appropriate holders based on proximity and requirements.
**Step 2:** ***Work Execution and Certification***
Documentation assistants will perform assigned tasks including compilation, organization, digitisation, and conversion of materials under the supervision and certification of the material holder. The quality and progress of work will be periodically reviewed by Tiatr Academy of Goa.
**Step 3:** ***Payment and Delivery***
Upon completion and certification of work, documentation assistants will receive honorarium payment on clock-hour basis as determined by Tiatr Academy of Goa. A copy of digitised material will be provided to the holder on Digital Versatile Disc or Pen-drive, while Tiatr Academy of Goa will retain a similar copy for its uses.
_*The Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to make any changes in the rules of the scheme._

faqs.question: Can I apply as a documentation assistant if I have skills in typing, scanning, and converting audio-video materials from analogue to digital format?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can apply as a documentation assistant if you are capable of performing tasks including compilation and organisation of materials, typing or word-processing of textual materials, scanning and converting by Optical Character Recognition, conversion of images by scanning or photographing with digital camera, and converting video or audio recordings from analogue to digital format.

faqs.question: What types of materials related to this art form are considered eligible for documentation and digitisation under this assistance program?
faqs.answer: Eligible materials include manuscripts, photos, handbills, advertisements, newspaper or magazine clippings, video and audio recordings that are related to this theatrical art form. These materials must be in possession of artistes, enthusiasts, or institutions.

faqs.question: Do I need to provide any specific identity document along with my application form when applying for this documentation assistance?
faqs.answer: Yes, you must submit a self-attested copy of Aadhaar Card along with your application form as it is mandatory according to the scheme rules. Ensure the copy is clear and properly self-attested.

faqs.question: Will I receive any financial compensation for allowing my collection of theatrical materials to be documented and digitised?
faqs.answer: Yes, you will receive a reasonable one-time incentive amount as decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa for converting your materials into electronic formats. The exact amount will be determined by the academy.

faqs.question: What happens to the digitised copies of my materials once the documentation work is completed by the assigned assistant?
faqs.answer: You will receive a copy of the digitised material on Digital Versatile Disc or Pen-drive, while Tiatr Academy of Goa will retain a similar copy for its institutional uses and preservation purposes.

faqs.question: How much will I be paid as a documentation assistant for the work I perform under this scheme?
faqs.answer: Documentation assistants will be paid an honorarium on clock-hour basis as determined by Tiatr Academy of Goa. The specific hourly rate will be decided by the academy.

faqs.question: Is there any preference given to certain candidates when selecting documentation assistants for this preservation and digitisation work?
faqs.answer: Yes, preference will be given to persons who are in proximity to the venue of the holdings. This ensures better coordination and accessibility for the documentation work.

faqs.question: What are the key details I need to provide in the application form for this documentation and research assistance program?
faqs.answer: The application form requires your name, complete address, contact number, email identification, Aadhaar Card number, and the specific aspect of this theatrical art form on which documentation can be undertaken.

faqs.question: Who will verify and certify that the documentation work performed by the assistant has been completed satisfactorily?
faqs.answer: The work done must be certified by the holder of the material. The material owner is responsible for verifying and certifying the quality and completion of documentation tasks.

faqs.question: If external agencies need to be hired for certain documentation tasks, will those costs be covered under this scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes, Tiatr Academy of Goa will reimburse costs incurred towards conversion according to rates determined by it if services of other agencies become necessary for the documentation work.

faqs.question: As a holder of valuable theatrical materials, what commitment must I make when applying for documentation assistance under this program?
faqs.answer: You must indicate willingness to permit and facilitate documentation and organisation tasks. This commitment ensures that documentation assistants can access and work with your materials effectively.

faqs.question: How does the academy ensure quality control and monitor the progress of documentation work being carried out?
faqs.answer: Tiatr Academy of Goa will periodically review the work undertaken and accordingly extend or curtail the assistantship based on the quality and progress of the documentation tasks.

faqs.question: What specific conversion and digitisation tasks might I be expected to perform as a documentation assistant in this preservation program?
faqs.answer: Tasks may include compilation and organisation of materials, typing or word-processing of textual materials, scanning and converting by Optical Character Recognition, conversion of images by scanning or photographing with digital camera, and converting video or audio recordings from analogue to digital format.

faqs.question: Can I suggest or recommend someone who lives near my location to work as a documentation assistant for my materials?
faqs.answer: Yes, as a material holder, you may indicate proximate candidates who are willing to undertake the documentation work when submitting your application to the academy.

name: Export Promotion Council Membership Reimbursement Scheme for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe
ministry: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
brief_description: Export Promotion Council Membership Reimbursement Scheme provides reimbursement to an SC/ST Micro & small enterprises(MSEs), on annual membership subscription fee / one-time subscription charges/entry fee charged by various Export Promotion Councils (EPC).
details: Launched by the Ministry Of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Export Promotion Council Membership Reimbursement Scheme is a sub scheme under National Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Hub (NSSH) scheme. Under this scheme, reimbursement will be provided to an Scheduled Caste (SC)/Scheduled Tribe (ST) Micro & small enterprises(MSEs), on annual membership subscription fee/one-time subscription charges/entry fee charged by various Export Promotion Councils (EPC).
benefits: **Reimbursement of Membership Fee:** Reimbursement of 80% or up to ₹20,000 (excluding GST and other applicable taxes), whichever is less, per financial year for SC/ST MSEs towards annual membership, one-time subscription, or entry fee charged by Export Promotion Councils (EPCs).
eligibility:
- Applicant should belong to Scheduled Caste(SC)/Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 
- He/She should represent any Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs).

application_process.steps:
**Step 1:** The applicant must visit the official portal of the [National SC-ST Hub](https://www.scsthub.in/nssh-schemes/).
**Step 2:** The applicant must click on the "Scheme name" and then click on “Sign Up” and register using basic details such as name, email ID, and mobile number.
**Step 3:** The applicant must create a password and complete the registration process.
**Step 4:** The applicant must log in using the registered credentials.
**Step 5:** The applicant must fill in the required details and submit the application online.

documents_required: Self-certified copy PAN card case of proprietorship, PAN card of SC/ST proprietor ought to be submitted
Self-certified copy of Caste certificate of proprietor/ all partners/ directors

Details of shareholding in case of partnership / Pvt. Ltd / LLP firm. In case of partnership concerns, shareholding of the enterprise would be required to ascertain status of the MSE as SC/ST MSE (shareholding of SC/ST entrepreneur to be > 51%). Attested copy of Partnership Deed for Partnership Firm / Memorandum and Article of Association in case of LLP/Private Limited Company are required
Attested copy of Certificate of valid Import & Export Code (IEC) allotted by the concerned office of the Joint/ Dy. Director General of Foreign Trade (DGFT)
Attested copy of valid Registration Cum Membership Certificate (RCMC) issued by the respective Export Promotion Council (EPC) post registration
Original/ Attested copy of Registration Cum Membership Certificate (RCMC) issued earlier by the respective EPC, in case of existing members renewing their memberships
Proof of transferred amount as reimbursement by NSSHO/ NSIC through PFMS under the scheme, where any such assistance is availed earlier with in the same financial year

Attested (signature with stamp) or original copy of membership fee payment receipt and system generated GST invoice (with breakup of fees paid (entrance fee, annual membership/subscription fee)) for total amount paid to respective Export Promotion Councils (EPCs)
Cancelled Cheque of the current account of the enterprise from which the EPC membership fee has been debited

faqs.question: What is Export Promotion Council Membership Fee Reimbursement Scheme?
faqs.answer: This scheme, provides reimbursement to an SC/ST Micro & small enterprises(MSEs), on annual membership subscription fee/one-time subscription charges/entry fee charged by various Export Promotion Councils (EPC).

faqs.question: Which department has launched this scheme?
faqs.answer: This scheme has been launched by the Ministry Of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria?
faqs.answer: SC/ST Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) are eligible for this scheme.

faqs.question: How should I apply to avail benefit under the scheme?
faqs.answer: You may apply online on National SC-ST website www.scsthub.in

faqs.answer: No.

name: Delhi Arogya Nidhi
department: Directorate General Of Health Services, Government NCT Of Delhi
brief_description: Delhi Arogya Nidhi (DAN) is a scheme to provide financial assistance upto ₹1.5 lacs to needy patients who have National Food Security Cards for the treatment of diseases in Government hospitals only.
details: The "Delhi Arogya Nidhi (DAN)" is a scheme implemented by the Directorate General of Health Services to provide financial assistance of up to ₹1.5 lacs to needy patients who have National Food Security Cards for treatment of diseases in Government hospitals only.
benefits: 1. Under the scheme, financial assistance of up to ₹1.5 lacs will be provided to needy patients who have National Food Security Cards for treatment of diseases in Government hospitals only.
eligibility:
1. Patients should have a National Food Security Card.
1. The patient must be a resident of Delhi and has to furnish domicile proof of residing in Delhi continuously for the last 3 years (prior to the date of submission of the application).
1. Treatment should be from the Government Hospital in Delhi.

application_process.steps:
**Step 01:** Visit the [official website](https://dgehs.delhi.gov.in/dghs/delhi-arogya-nidhi) to download the [Application Form](https://health.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/Health/generic_multiple_files/totalform.pdf) for Financial Aid.
**Step 02:** Fill out the form with all requisites details.
**Step 03:** The photocopies of all documents are to be attached with the application and the original is to be brought at the time of submission of same for verification.
**Step 04:** Applicant has to submit an undertaking for his signature verification as given in the application form.
**Step 05:** Application to be submitted in Patient Welfare Cell, Directorate of Health Services, 6th Floor, F-17, Karkardooma, (Near Karkardooma Court), Delhi-110032.

documents_required: Proof of continuous residence in Delhi for the last 3years through any one of the following documents:
Birth certificate (In case the patient is a minor)
Original Estimate Certificate duly signed by Consultant/ Medical Superintendent/ Chief Medical Officer of the Hospital
Two photographs of the patient, duly attested by the treating doctor.
A copy of the National Food Security Card.

Note: Applicant has to submit an undertaking for his signature verification as given in the [application form](https://health.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/Health/generic_multiple_files/totalform.pdf).

faqs.question: What is the “Delhi Arogya Nidhi (DAN) “scheme?
faqs.answer: DAN is a scheme initiated to provide financial assistance of up to [?]1.5 lakhs to needy patients holding the National Food Security Card for the treatment of diseases in government hospitals in Delhi.

faqs.question: Who is eligible under the "Delhi Arogya Nidhi" Scheme?
faqs.answer: Patients holding the National Food Security Card are eligible for financial aid under the scheme.

faqs.question: What is the maximum financial aid provided under the 'DAN' Scheme?
faqs.answer: DAN offers financial assistance up to [?]1.5 lakhs to eligible patients.

faqs.question: Where can eligible patients avail treatment under this scheme?
faqs.answer: Treatment is restricted to government hospitals in Delhi.

faqs.question: What documents are required to establish eligibility for the scheme?
faqs.answer: Essential documents include the National Food Security Card, proof of continuous residence in Delhi for the last 3 years, and other identification documents.

faqs.question: Can a minor apply for the DAN grant?
faqs.answer: Yes, a minor patient can apply, and the Electoral Voter's Photo Identity Card or birth certificate is required as proof.

faqs.question: Are non-Delhi residents eligible for the assistance under DAN?
faqs.answer: No, patients must be residents of Delhi and furnish domicile proof of residing in Delhi continuously for the last 3 years.

faqs.question: How to apply for the DAN grant?
faqs.answer: The eligible applicant may submit the Application Form at the Patient Welfare Cell, Directorate of Health Services, 6th Floor, F-17, Karkardooma, Delhi-110032, using the prescribed proforma.

name: Kerala State Young Scientist Awards
department: Kerala State Council For Science, Technology And Environment
brief_description: The “Kerala State Young Scientist Awards” by the KSCSTE are intended to honour talented young Scientists in recognition of their outstanding contributions in any branch of science and technology coming within the purview of the Council.
details:
The “Kerala State Young Scientist Awards” by the KSCSTE are intended to honour talented young Scientists in recognition of their outstanding contributions in any branch of science and technology coming within the purview of the Council. The research carried out independently in Kerala by young scientists of Indian origin with Ph.D. in any branch of Science and technology who have been working in Kerala for the last three years will be taken into consideration for the award.
 Candidates may be nominated by Vice-Chancellors of Universities in Kerala, Directors of R & D Centres, Heads of Institutions & departments and Fellows of Academies. Nominations will be valid for 3 years or the eligibility age whichever is earlier. Selection will be through a thorough review/evaluation by an expert committee.
benefits:
1. Each Awardee will be presented with a certificate and a cash prize of ₹50,000/-.
 1. The recipient may be considered by the Council for a research grant of ₹50 lakhs after due consideration of the research project with the help of an expert committee.
 1. The Awardee, within 3 years of the receipt of the award, will be considered for a visit abroad to present the research work at a conference.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Ph.D. holder with 3 years Post-Doctoral experience.
 1. The applicant should have working experience in any R&D/Academic institution in Kerala continuously for the last 3 years.
 1. The age of the applicant should not be more than 37 years as on 31st December in the notifying year.

application_process.steps:
> **Nomination Procedure:**

**Step 01:** Applications are invited through advertisement every year.
**Step 02:** Candidates may be nominated by Vice-Chancellors of Universities in Kerala, Directors of Research Institutes/ R & D Centres of Industries, Heads of University Departments, Principals of Colleges with approved centers of research, Fellows of the Indian National Science Academy, Indian Academy of Sciences, National Academy of Sciences, India, Indian National Academy of Engineering and Indian Academy of Agricultural Sciences.
**Step 03:** Nominations will be valid for 3 years or the eligibility age whichever is earlier. However, a fresh nomination (only once) can be made, if the nominee has not yet crossed the age bar.
**Step 04:** Nominations in the prescribed format along with all supporting documents must reach the Director, KSCSTE, Sasthra Bhavan, Pattom P.O., Thiruvananthapuram – 695004.
**Note:** Nominations that are not complete or received after the due date will not be considered.
> **Selection Procedure:**

**Step 01:** Candidates recommended by the screening committee after a rigorous criteria-based screening will be invited for the presentation of their research work.
**Step 02:** The candidates will be informed of their selection for the award individually by mail.
**Step 03:** The awards will be distributed during the inaugural session of the Kerala Science Congress by the Chief Minister. The Awardees have to make a presentation of the award-winning work in the Plenary Session of the Kerala Science Congress.
> **Contact Details:**

The Head, Science, Technology Promotion Division,
Kerala State Council for Science, Technology and Environment (KSCSTE)
Sasthra Bhavan, Pattom, Thiruvananthapuram – 695 004

The objective of the scheme is to provide a subsidy for the purchase of a bicycle to laborers working in the organized sector, enabling them to commute between their residence and workplace.

name: Arun Pig Development Scheme
nodal_department: Animal husbandry, Veterinary and Dairy Department
department: District Animal Husbandry And Veterinary Office
brief_description: The scheme “Arun Pig Development Scheme” was launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry, Veterinary & Dairy Development, Government of Arunachal Pradesh in the financial year 2019-20 with a focus on pig rearing.
details:
The scheme “Arun Pig Development Scheme” was launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry, Veterinary & Dairy Development, Government of Arunachal Pradesh in the financial year 2019-20 with a focus on pig rearing. Among the livestock species, the pig finds an important place as it is being reared by socio-economically weaker sections of the society especially in the states like Arunachal Pradesh where most of people prefer non-veg cuisines with special attractions for Pork. The pig as compared to other livestock species has a great potential to contribute to a faster economic return to the farmers, because of certain inherent traits like high fecundity, better-feed conversion efficiency, early maturity, and short generation interval. Pig farming also requires small investments in buildings and equipment.
**Objective**

 - Genetic improvement of the indigenous pigs of Arunachal Pradesh for productivity enhancement by crossbreeding with the exotic breed(s) to a desired level of combination of exotic and local inheritance,
 - Improvement of indigenous pig rearing by the rural people by selective breeding,
 - Livelihood earning
 - Maintenance of well-planned crossbred animals at farmers’ field
 - Expansion of piggery husbandry and support mechanism to propagate pig rearing in rural areas
 - Ensure that the breeds introduced, and crossbreds produced and propagated in the state are adapted to local environmental conditions and emerging climatic challenges,
 - Strengthen support mechanisms and development of the sector in respect of feeding, housing, and health care besides value addition and marketing of the product with value chain development.
 - Scientific rearing and motivation of farmers for integrated piggery farming.

**Important Features**

 - Seeing the low interest of the actual grass root level farmer for the credit link schemes and their poor success rate, a new venture for piggery development in the state through direct intervention by the Department of AHV&DD, GoAP in terms of upgradation of genetic resources, and other peripherals, a new and innovative scheme is proposed for Budget Announcement 2019-20 for sustainable development and poverty alleviation of Farmers through Pig Rearing in potential districts of Arunachal Pradesh.
 - Livelihood earning, improvement of indigenous pig rearing by the rural people by selective breeding along with maintenance of well-planned crossbred animals at farmers’ fields.
 - Expansion of piggery husbandry and support mechanism to propagate pig rearing in rural areas.
 - Ensure that the breeds introduced, and crossbreds produced and propagated in the state are adapted to local environmental conditions and emerging climatic challenges.

name: Medical Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Medical Assistance" scheme provides financial assistance to Construction Workers hospitalized for five or more days due to an accident or disease. The financial assistance shall be ₹500/- for the first 5 days and ₹50/- each for the remaining days, subject to a maximum of ₹1,5000/-.
details: The "Medical Assistance" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this scheme, the Board may sanction financial assistance to the Construction Workers who are hospitalized for five or more days due to an accident or any disease. The financial assistance shall be ₹500/- for the first 5 days and ₹50/- each for the remaining days, subject to a maximum of ₹1,500/-.
benefits: Financial Assistance of ₹500/- for initial minimum period of 5 days and thereafter ₹50/- per day upto maximum of ₹1500/- per month, credited within 15 days through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The applicant should have completed the age of 18 years.
- The applicant should not have completed the age of 60 years during the preceding 12 months in the construction work.
- The beneficiary should be contributing to the Board's Fund.
- The applicant should not have defaulted in payment of contribution to the Board for a continuous period of more than one year.
- The applicant should have been hospitalized for five or more days due to an accident or any disease.

application_process.steps:
> **Registration**

**Step 1:** The interested construction worker should visit the Office of the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (Industrial Estate, Thattanchavady, Puducherry - 605 009) and obtain the prescribed format of the registration form free of cost from the concerned authority exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
**Step 2:** In the registration form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required), add a declaration stating that you are a construction worker, mentioning your worksite. 
**Step 3:** The interested construction worker should submit the duly filled and signed registration form and the documents to the concerned authority.
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the registration form has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).
**Step 5:** Upon verification by the inspectors under the Act towards genuineness, the concerned worker will be enrolled as a beneficiary with the approval of the Secretary (Board). 
_*The beneficiary should pay the registration of ₹25/- at the time of enrollment and ₹100/- per year as an annual subscription._
_*The Board collects ₹300/- as a renewal fee once in three years._

> **Application**

**Step 1:** The interested construction worker should visit the Office of the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (Industrial Estate, Thattanchavady, Puducherry - 605 009) and obtain the prescribed format of the application form free of cost from the concerned authority exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
OR
The interested construction worker should take print of the prescribed format of the application form provided in the section "Application for Welfare Benefits" on [Page No. 77](https://labour.py.gov.in/sites/default/files/citizens-charter-2020.pdf) of the Citizen's Charter.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** The interested construction worker should submit the duly filled and signed application form and the documents to the concerned authority.
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application form has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).
**NOTE:** The application should be submitted within one year from the date of discharge.

documents_required: Duly Filled and Signed Application Form.
Birth Certificate/Transfer Certificate/Doctor Certificate for Age Verification.
Experience Certificate to Be Obtained From a Registered Engineer/contractor/association/trade Union, Serving as Evidence of Being a Construction Worker.
Proof of Blood Group (Medical Health Card or Laboratory Certificate).
Family Particulars/status and Nomination Details of the Beneficiaries.
Certificate From the Revenue Department or Social Welfare Department or Anganwadi Officials of the Respective Area.
Medical Certificate issued by the competent authority (RMO).

faqs.answer: The scheme outlines a daily payment structure, and there is no provision mentioned for a lump sum payment.

faqs.question: How can one apply for registration of establishments employing building workers in Goa?

name: Palak Mata-Pita Yojana
brief_description: The "Palak Mata-Pita Yojana" introduced on 29th August, 2009 by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, provides a monthly assistance of ₹3000 to foster parents raising orphaned children or children whose mother has remarried after the father's death.
details: The "Palak Mata-Pita Yojana" introduced on 29th August, 2009 by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, aims to provide monthly assistance of Rs. 3000/- is paid to the close relative, guardian or relative who is taking care of the orphaned children who are studying and whose mother and father are both deceased or whose father is deceased and the mother has remarried. This assistance is paid through DBT.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** ₹3,000/- per month.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a close relative, guardian, or foster parent taking care of the child.
 - The applicant must be caring for a child aged between 0 to 18 years.
 - The applicant must be taking care of a child whose both parents are deceased, or whose father is deceased and mother has remarried.
 - The applicant must ensure that the child between 3 to 6 years is enrolled in an Anganwadi center.
 - The applicant must ensure that the child above 6 years is enrolled in a school for compulsory education.
 - The applicant must submit a certificate from the school or institution every year confirming the child’s ongoing education.
 - The applicant must have an annual family income not exceeding ₹27,000/- in rural areas.
 - The applicant must have an annual family income not exceeding ₹36,000/- in urban areas.

application_process.steps:
**Step 1:** Go to the [eSamajKalyan portal](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/) and Register/Login.
**Step 2:** Fill in the online application form under "Palak Mata-Pita Yojana".
**Step 3:** Upload the required documents and Submit the application.

faqs.question: What is the "Palak Mata-Pita Yojana" and who benefits from it?
faqs.answer: The Palak Mata-Pita Yojana is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Gujarat that provides monthly financial assistance to foster parents or guardians who are taking care of orphaned children or children whose surviving parent has remarried after the death of the other parent.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for financial assistance under this scheme?
faqs.answer: A person is eligible to apply for this scheme if they are a close relative, guardian, or foster parent of a child between the ages of 0 to 18 years, and if the child’s biological parents are either both deceased or the father is deceased and the mother has remarried.

faqs.question: What is the financial assistance amount provided through the Palak Mata-Pita Yojana?
faqs.answer: Under this scheme, the Government of Gujarat provides a monthly financial assistance of ₹3000 directly to the bank account of the eligible foster parent or guardian through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

faqs.question: Is there an income limit that applicants must meet to receive benefits under this scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes, to qualify for the Palak Mata-Pita Yojana, the applicant’s family income must not exceed ₹27,000/- per year in rural areas and ₹36,000/- per year in urban areas, as certified by a competent authority such as a Magistrate.

faqs.question: Is the scheme applicable to children who still have one surviving parent?
faqs.answer: Yes, the scheme also applies to children whose father is deceased and whose mother has remarried, provided the child is not living with the biological parent who remarried.

faqs.question: Is there a specific authority that processes and approves applications under this scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes, the applications are reviewed and approved by the Sponsorship and Approval Committee (SFCAC) at the district level, which functions under the leadership of the District Social Security Officer and ensures compliance with government rules.

faqs.question: Is there a cost involved in submitting the application for this scheme?
faqs.answer: No, there is no cost or fee associated with submitting the application for the Palak Mata-Pita Yojana as it is completely free of charge.

faqs.question: Are children required to be enrolled in an educational institution to remain eligible for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes, children above the age of 6 years must be enrolled in a recognized school, and the guardian must submit a certificate every year confirming that the child’s education is ongoing.

faqs.question: What educational requirement applies to children below 6 years of age?
faqs.answer: Children between the ages of 3 and 6 years must be admitted to an Anganwadi center as part of the child development and education support requirements of the scheme.

faqs.question: What happens if the child discontinues education during the benefit period?
faqs.answer: If the child discontinues education or is not enrolled in an educational institution as required, the financial assistance may be withdrawn or discontinued until compliance is re-established.

faqs.question: Where can applicants seek help or clarification regarding the scheme or the application process?
faqs.answer: Applicants seeking assistance or clarification can contact the office of the District Social Security Officer or the District Child Protection Officer in their respective district, where they will be guided through the application process and other related procedures.

faqs.question: Is the "Palak Mata-Pita Yojana" applicable throughout the state of Gujarat?
faqs.answer: Yes, the scheme has been implemented across all districts in the state of Gujarat since its launch on 29th August 2009, and it continues to be available to all eligible applicants statewide.

name: Financial Assistance For Allied Cultural Activities
