brief_description: Under this scheme, education loans are provided at subsidized interest rates to students belonging to Thakor and Koli communities for pursuing graduate and postgraduate studies in fields such as engineering, medical, MBA, and MCA.

name: Water Connection for ₹100 to BPL/Poor Families Residing in Urban Areas of Uttarakhand
department: Uttarakhand Jal Sansthan
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide affordable and accessible drinking water connections to BPL and economically weaker families residing in urban areas of Uttarakhand, ensuring equitable access to safe water for eligible households.
details: The scheme “Water Connection at ₹100 for BPL / Poor Families Residing in Urban Areas of Uttarakhand” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Jal Sansthan under the Drinking Water Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide affordable and accessible drinking water connections to BPL and economically weaker families residing in urban areas of Uttarakhand, ensuring equitable access to safe water for eligible households.
benefits: Under this scheme, a water connection is provided for a nominal fee of ₹100/- to eligible beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of an urban area in Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant’s family must belong to a BPL (Below Poverty Line) or economically weaker category.
 1. The applicant must own a plot of land measuring up to 100 square meters and have constructed, be constructing, or plan to construct a building on the same plot; such applicants will be eligible for a water connection at ₹100/-.

application_process.steps:
- Uttarakhand Jal Sansthan allows BPL/poor families residing in urban areas of the state to apply for a drinking water connection either online through the departmental website [https://ujs.uk.gov.in](https://ujs.uk.gov.in/) or offline by obtaining the application form directly from the nearest departmental collection center. - Applicants will be notified of the acceptance or rejection of their applications via SMS. If the application is approved, the applicant must pay the connection fee. The connection fee can be paid online at [https://ujs.uk.gov.in](https://ujsbill.uk.gov.in/) by clicking on Online Services and selecting the New Connection Payment link using a debit/credit card, net banking, or cash card, or it can be paid directly at the collection center. - Applicants are required to pay an application fee of ₹25/-, submit a non-judicial stamp paper of ₹100/-, and a domestic water connection fee of ₹100/-. Aadhaar card, BPL certificate or income certificate, and relevant housing documents are also required.
 - Applications for 15 mm or 20 mm drinking water connections, or for personal sewer connections of any size, will be approved or rejected by the concerned Executive Engineer within 15 days after technical evaluation. 
 - Applications for 25 mm to 40 mm drinking water connections will be approved or rejected by the concerned Executive Engineer within 30 days after technical evaluation. 
 - Applications for 50 mm drinking water connections or colony/institution sewer connections will be approved or rejected by the concerned Superintending Engineer within 30 days after technical evaluation.
 - Drinking water applications of 50 mm or larger will be approved or rejected by the concerned General Manager within 30 days after technical evaluation.
 - Once the site inspection is complete and the details are verified, the approved water connection will be provided to the applicant.

documents_required: Proof of ownership or construction on the plot of land

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?

name: Nalanda Award
brief_description: The "Nalanda Award" implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, recognizes organizations for exceptional work in the field of social welfare, particularly for the socially and educationally disadvantaged sections.
details: The "Nalanda Award" implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, aims to honor organizations that have significantly contributed to the upliftment of socially and educationally backward communities. This state-level recognition encourages continued efforts in the field of social welfare and highlights best practices that can be replicated across the state.
benefits: - Financial assistance to the selected organization.
eligibility:
- The organization must have made outstanding contributions in the field of social welfare.
 - The welfare work should benefit socially and educationally backward classes (SEBC).

application_process.steps:
> **Registration Process:**

**Step 1:** Go to the [eSamajKalyan portal](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/index.aspx?HodID=Mgt3fh4h1dSAcTIdCEHhzQ==) and navigate to the "Nalanda Award" section under the menu option.
**Step 2:** Click on Apply Now.
**Step 3:** Click on "New User? Please Register Here".
**Step 4:** Enter the required details and click Register.

> **Application Process:**

**Step 2:** Read the scheme details carefully and click OK.
**Step 3:** If your permanent address is correct, confirm it. Otherwise, enter your correct address.

faqs.question: What is the "Nalanda Award" and why is it given?
faqs.answer: The Nalanda Award is a state-level recognition conferred by the Government of Gujarat to honor organizations that have made outstanding and impactful contributions in the field of social welfare, specifically for the benefit of socially and educationally backward communities.

faqs.question: Who can apply for the Nalanda Award under this scheme?
faqs.answer: Only organizations, not individuals, that are actively involved in social welfare activities targeting the upliftment of socially and educationally disadvantaged groups in Gujarat are eligible to apply for the Nalanda Award.

faqs.question: Is an individual or private citizen eligible to receive the Nalanda Award?
faqs.answer: No, the Nalanda Award is not intended for individuals; it is exclusively designed to recognize organizations that have collectively contributed to the welfare of SEBC communities through structured initiatives.

faqs.question: Is the Nalanda Award scheme available to organizations across all regions of Gujarat?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Nalanda Award is a statewide initiative, and organizations operating in any part of Gujarat are eligible to apply as long as they meet the necessary criteria.

faqs.question: What kind of support does an organization receive upon being selected for the Nalanda Award?
faqs.answer: An organization selected for the Nalanda Award receives financial assistance from the Government of Gujarat along with formal recognition for its outstanding work in social welfare.

faqs.question: On what basis is the final selection of an organization made for the Nalanda Award?
faqs.answer: The selection of an organization for the Nalanda Award is based on several criteria, including the documented impact of its work, the authenticity and sustainability of its initiatives, and its overall contribution to the welfare of SEBC communities.

faqs.question: Can a newly established organization apply for the "Nalanda Award"?
faqs.answer: A newly formed organization can apply for the Nalanda Award provided it has verifiable proof of impactful work carried out in the field of social welfare, even within a short span of time.

faqs.question: What is the mode of application for the "Nalanda Award"?
faqs.answer: The application process for the Nalanda Award is conducted entirely online through the official portal [https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/), where organizations can register, fill out the form, and upload necessary documents.

faqs.question: Which documents must be submitted by an organization to apply for the Nalanda Award?
faqs.answer: To apply for the Nalanda Award, an organization must submit essential documents such as a valid Aadhar Card, a bank passbook or a cancelled cheque, recent passport-sized photographs, and the completed application form.

faqs.question: Whom should an organization contact in case they need help or clarification regarding the scheme?
faqs.answer: Organizations requiring assistance or further information about the Nalanda Award scheme can reach out to the Social Justice and Empowerment Department through their official website at [https://sje.gujarat.gov.in](https://sje.gujarat.gov.in/).

name: Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm

brief_description: The "Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm" scheme introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, provides financial assistance in the form of an interest subsidy to livestock farmers to take up animal husbandry as a sustainable business.
details: The "Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm" scheme introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, provides financial assistance in the form of an interest subsidy to livestock farmers to take up animal husbandry as a sustainable business. The scheme benefits livestock farmers by reducing their financial burden, thereby promoting large-scale dairy farming.
benefits: - **Interest Subsidy:** Eligible farmers receive an interest subsidy of 12% on the unit cost fixed by NABARD or banks.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a livestock farmer, which includes agricultural laborers, small and marginal farmers, landless people, Maldhari (pastoralists), and educated unemployed individuals.
 - The applicant should have taken a loan from a bank for dairy farming (1 to 20 milch animals).

> **Note:**

 - Availability of the Land, livestock and water facilities with the Livestock Owners.

**Step 5:** Click on the "Update Application" button to add corrections to the application.

**Step 7:** Take a print out of the confirmed application and submit Related Documents through to concern Taluka office.
**Step 8:** Applicant can also check their Application Status/View/Print/Upload Application details from the below link: [https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/public/frm_Applicant_Corner.aspx](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/public/frm_Applicant_Corner.aspx)

faqs.question: What is the objective of the "Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm" scheme?

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Any livestock farmer, including agricultural laborers, small and marginal farmers, landless individuals, Maldhari (pastoralists), and educated unemployed individuals, is eligible to apply.

faqs.question: What is the primary benefit of this scheme?
faqs.answer: The scheme provides a 12% interest subsidy on loans taken for setting up dairy farms with 1 to 20 milch animals (cows and buffaloes), reducing the financial burden on farmers.

faqs.question: Is this scheme available for Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) livestock owners?
faqs.answer: Yes, the scheme is available for SC and ST livestock owners, ensuring inclusivity and financial support for marginalized communities.

faqs.answer: Yes, the Livestock Owners must have land or access to land along with necessary livestock and water facilities to be eligible for the scheme.

faqs.question: What type of animals are covered under this scheme?
faqs.answer: This scheme is applicable to milch animals such as cows and buffaloes for dairy farming purposes.

faqs.question: Can an individual apply without taking a bank loan?
faqs.answer: No, it is mandatory for the applicant to take a loan from a bank in order to be eligible for the interest subsidy under this scheme.

faqs.question: Where should the applicant submit their application?
faqs.answer: The application must be submitted online through the [I Khedut](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/) portal for further processing and verification.

faqs.question: What documents are required to apply for the scheme?
faqs.answer: The applicant must submit proof of land or house ownership, bank loan approval documents, and other necessary documents required by the bank.

faqs.question: Who verifies the application after submission?
faqs.answer: The application is verified by the Veterinary Officer at the local veterinary dispensary and then sent to the Deputy Director of Animal Husbandry, District Panchayat for approval.

name: Chief Minister’s Paryatan Vikas Yojana
department: Department Of Tourism, Arunachal Pradesh
brief_description: The scheme “Chief Minister’s Paryatan Vikas Yojna (CMPVY)” was launched by Government of Arunachal Pradesh is to develop tourism facilities in the state to attract more tourism.
details:
The scheme “Chief Minister’s Paryatan Vikas Yojna (CMPVY)” was launched by the Government of Arunachal Pradesh to develop tourism facilities in the state to attract more tourism.
The scheme has three components –
a) Development support to Patisserie and Food courts,
b) Development support for Homestays,
c) Development of adventure sports by financial support in the procurement of equipment.
**Objective:**

 - To promote tourism in the State and thereby livelihood for the locals. 

**Important Features:**

 - Patisserie and food courts in popular tourist spots and important towns/ tourist places of Arunachal Pradesh
 - Value addition to Home Stay operators, which include renovation of 2 adequately sized well-furnished rooms with attached toilet with shower, geyser, and western toilet
 - Purchase of various types of adventure tourism equipment such as rafts, kayaks, Quad bikes, lobs, lip lines, Bungee jumps, etc.
benefits:
1. Direct loan subsidy of ₹5.00 lakh is provided to open Patisserie.
1. Homestays and procure equipment for adventure tourism.
eligibility:
1. Any Arunachal Pradesh domicile can apply to avail of the benefit of this scheme.
2. For Homestays: Beneficiaries should be registered with the Department of Tourism.
3. Those Homestay operators trained with the Department of Tourism will be given priority.
4. For Cab Service Operators and Patisseries, Food courts: Beneficiaries should be registered as tour operators with the Department of Tourism.

application_process.steps:
**Step 01:** For taking benefit of this scheme, the applicant needs to visit the nearest District Tourism Office, Arunachal Pradesh.
**Step 02:** Application in the prescribed format may be received from the concerned office.
**Step 03:** The applicant needs to fill the application form completely and attach all the relevant documents. Thereafter, the applicant may submit the application form to the concerned office.
**Step 04:** After successful verification, the applicant will be interviewed and assessed by the District Administration (District Tourism Officer) before he/she receives the benefit.

Bank Account number/ front page of the passbook
Registration certificate with the Department of Tourism.
Training certificates of Dept. of Tourism (if applicable)
Registration certificate as a tour operator with the dept. of Tourism (for Cab Service Operators and Patisseries, Food courts)
Any other document, as requested by the Department of Tourism.

name: D. D. Kosambi Research Fellowship Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Goa State Best Library and Best Librarian Award" has been designed by the Directorate of Art and Culture, Government of Goa to encourage Goan Scholars to undertake research in the field of Goan history, culture, arts, social studies etc. Three fellowships shall be awarded.
details:
The scheme "Goa State Best Library and Best Librarian Award" has been designed by the Directorate of Art and Culture, Government of Goa to encourage Goan Scholars to undertake research in the field of Goan history, culture, arts, social studies etc. Three fellowships shall be awarded, upto one at junior, upto one at senior & upto one at the post-doctoral level each for research in the specified areas every year.

> **Objectives**

1. To encourage the Goan scholars to undertake research in the areas of society, economy, polity, history, art and culture of Goa. Only topics that are closely connected to Goa will be accepted. However authentic topics pertaining to Goa may also be considered for the fellowship depending upon the decision taken by the selection committee constituted for the purpose. 
1. To create, promote and develop research activities in the State of Goa. 
1. To promote interdisciplinary research programmes in colleges and universities.
benefits:
1. Eligible scholars for the junior category shall be awarded a fellowship up to ₹ 15,000/- per month for a maximum period of 2 years, on a case-to-case basis. 
1. Eligible scholars for senior & post-doctoral categories shall be awarded a fellowship of ₹ 20,000/- per month for a maximum period of 2 years, on a case-to-case basis. 
1. However, the applicant who undertakes to complete the research work on a full-time basis may be awarded the scholarship upto ₹ 30,000/- per month. In such cases, the research period shall be as decided by the selection committee. 

> **Number of Fellowships**

A maximum of one fellowship in each category shall be awarded every year. 

**NOTE:** The amount of fellowship shall be assessed on the recommendation of the selection committee after the submission of his/her project.
exclusions: A fellow will not be eligible for any other fellowship offered by the Department in any other category for a period of 10 years from the date of the submission of his/her project. Any grace period/extension will not be considered under the quantum of the fellowship financial assistance.
eligibility:
1. Any individual who has completed post-graduation and is upto 35 years of age shall be eligible to undertake research in the junior category.
1. Any individual who has completed post-graduation and is above the age of 35 shall be eligible to undertake research in the senior category. 
1. Any individual who has completed a PhD shall be eligible to undertake research in the post-doctoral category. There shall be no age bar in this category. 
1. The fellowship shall be awarded to any scholar only once in his lifetime under each category.

application_process.steps:
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the Directorate Of Art & Culture, Government of Goa, 5th Floor, Shram Shakti Bhavan, Panaji, Patto, Panaji, Goa - 403001
**Step 2:** Take a print of the proforma of the application form of the respective scheme, or request a hard copy from the concerned authority.
**Step 3:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest if required).
**Step 4:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the **ACO-II, Directorate of Art & Culture, Phone: 0832-2404623, Email: aco3-dac.goa@nic.in.**

documents_required: Birth Certificate (Photo Copy Attested by Gazette Officer)
Fifteen Years Certificate of Residence in Goa/ Proof of Residence in Goa i.e. School Leaving Certificate etc.
Certificate of Passing of Maximum Qualification.

faqs.question: Can you elaborate on the role of the Directorate of Art and Culture in administering this fellowship scheme?
faqs.answer: The Directorate of Art and Culture is responsible for implementing and managing the fellowship scheme. This includes advertising the scheme, receiving applications, constituting the selection committee, disbursing fellowship amounts, and monitoring the progress of research.

faqs.question: Can a research fellow apply for the D. D. Kosambi Research Fellowship again after completing one term?
faqs.answer: No, the scheme specifies that a fellow is not eligible for any other fellowship offered by the Department for a period of 10 years from the date of submitting their project. Therefore, they cannot apply for the same fellowship again within this period.

faqs.question: How are research fellows expected to disseminate the findings of their research?
faqs.answer: Research fellows are encouraged to publish their research findings in reputed academic journals or present them at conferences and seminars. Disseminating research findings is an essential part of contributing to the academic community.

faqs.question: Can you explain the selection process for the D. D. Kosambi Research Fellowship Scheme in more detail?
faqs.answer: The selection process involves the constitution of a selection committee. The committee assesses applications and recommends eligible scholars based on their research proposals, qualifications, and achievements. The fellowship amount is determined by the committee after reviewing the submitted research project.

faqs.question: What is the maximum duration of the fellowship, and how is the fellowship amount determined?
faqs.answer: The fellowship for junior category scholars can be awarded for a maximum of 2 years, and for senior and post-doctoral category scholars, it can also be awarded for a maximum of 2 years. However, if the research work is undertaken on a full-time basis, the fellowship amount can be up to Rs. 30,000 per month, with the research period determined by the selection committee. The amount is assessed based on the recommendation of the selection committee after the submission of the research project.

faqs.question: Are there any restrictions on receiving other fellowships during the research period?
faqs.answer: Yes, a fellow who receives this fellowship is not eligible for any other fellowship offered by the Department for a period of 10 years from the date of submitting their project.

faqs.question: How many times can a scholar receive this fellowship under each category?
faqs.answer: A scholar can receive this fellowship only once in their lifetime under each category.

faqs.question: Can the educational qualifications requirement be relaxed for exceptionally talented scholars?
faqs.answer: Yes, for exceptionally talented scholars with a proven record and authentic work, the educational qualifications requirement may be relaxed if recommended by the Selection Committee.

faqs.question: Is there an age limit for the senior and post-doctoral categories?
faqs.answer: There is no age limit for the post-doctoral category. Individuals who have completed post-graduation and are above the age of 35 are eligible for the senior category.

faqs.question: What is the age eligibility for the junior category of research fellows?
faqs.answer: Individuals who have completed post-graduation and are up to 35 years of age are eligible for the junior category.

faqs.question: What types of research topics are eligible for consideration under this fellowship?
faqs.answer: Research topics closely connected to Goa, including society, economy, polity, history, art, and culture, are eligible. Authentic topics related to Goa may also be considered based on the decision of the selection committee.

faqs.question: How many research fellowships are awarded under this scheme each year?
faqs.answer: The scheme awards three fellowships each year, with one at the junior level, one at the senior level, and one at the post-doctoral level.

faqs.question: What is the main objective of the D. D. Kosambi Research Fellowship Scheme?
faqs.answer: The main objective of the scheme is to encourage Goan scholars to undertake research in the fields of Goan history, culture, arts, social studies, and related areas.

name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to aged and needy Goan artists who have lost the source of income due to the pandemic. The scheme provides relief in the form of financial assistance amounting to a min. of ₹5,000/- (lumpsum) up to a max. of ₹10,000/- (lumpsum) to eligible artists.
details: The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi" was launched by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. The "Pandemics" component of the scheme aims to provide financial assistance to aged and needy Goan artists who have lost the source of income due to the pandemic. The scheme provides relief in the form of financial assistance amounting to a minimum of ₹5,000/- (lumpsum) up to a maximum of ₹10,000/- (lumpsum) to eligible artists affected by the COVID-19 pandemic. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline at the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa.
benefits:
- One-time financial assistance in the range of ₹5,000/- to ₹10,000/- (lumpsum) per eligible artist, as decided by the committee.
- Released in the Bank Account (Nationalized Bank) of the artist. The disbursement is done in the form of Electronic Clearing Service mode.
exclusions:
- Scheme will not be applicable to the beneficiaries of Kala Samman who get monthly pensions from Department of Art & Culture, Government of Goa and also to those who are receiving any other pension /financial assistance from the Government (Centre/State). 
- The applicant working in private agency/company/institution on regular basis (on a regular payroll) are not eligible. However, the employees on contract/daily wages shall be considered provided their individual income from all sources does not exceed Rs.1.50 lakhs per annum.
eligibility:
- The artist must be a resident of Goa.
- The artist must be above 18 years of age.
- The artist must have lost the source of income due to the pandemic of COVID-19.
- The individual income of the artist (from all the sources) must not exceed ₹1,50,000/- per annum. 
- The artist should be working and contributing in the field of art and culture fields, i.e. Music/Dance/Drama/Tiatr/ Folk/Kir tan/Bhajan/Painting/Sculpture/Literature/Cantarists/Sahittik/Poets/Photographers/traditional Handicraft etc. 
- Artists should be in need of such financial assistance as contemplated in the scheme. 
- The artist should solely be dependent on the art related activities/programmes. 
- The artist shall not be a Government employee or an employee of Autonomous bodies, Corporations nor pensioner of any organization.

application_process.steps:
**Step 1:** Visit the office of the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa, and collect the prescribed application form for the scheme.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the completed application form along with all required documents directly to the ***Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa.***

##### ***Post-Application Processes***
**Step 1:** The Directorate shall forward the application to the sub-committee for scrutinizing the application thoroughly. The Director shall give its recommendations to the sub-committee.
**Step 2:** The sub-committee shall consider the received applications and recommend the applicants which are considered fit by the sub-committee to avail the benefits under this scheme. The committee shall decide the quantum of assistance to be released to the needy artist.
**Step 3:** After the committee decides on the quantum of assistance, the approval from the Government shall be obtained for disbursement of the financial assistance.
**Step 4:** After obtaining Government approval, the Director shall disburse the one-time financial assistance amount to the applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode to the bank account.

documents_required: Proof of Recent Contribution in the field of Art and Culture
Self-signed Affidavit/Declaration (on ₹50/- Stamp Paper) regarding the Individual Income (from all sources).
_*Either a Proof or a Self-signed Affidavit/Declaration may be required from the applicant regarding the following -_
_Loss of the source of income due to the pandemic of COVID-19._
_Solely dependence on the art related activities/programmes._

faqs.answer: The applicant must be above 18 years of age and must have lost their source of income due to the COVID-19 pandemic to qualify for this assistance.

faqs.answer: Yes, employees working on contract or daily wages are considered eligible, provided their individual annual income from all sources does not exceed ₹1,50,000/-.

faqs.answer: The individual annual income of the artist from all sources must not exceed ₹1,50,000/- per annum to be eligible for this pandemic relief.

faqs.question: Are artists who are currently receiving monthly pensions under the Kala Samman scheme eligible to apply for this assistance?
faqs.answer: No, beneficiaries of Kala Samman who receive monthly pensions from the Department of Art & Culture are not eligible for this scheme.

faqs.answer: The financial assistance ranges from a minimum of ₹5,000/- to a maximum of ₹10,000/- as a lumpsum amount per eligible artist.

faqs.question: Can a government employee or a pensioner from any organization apply for financial assistance under the pandemic relief provision?
faqs.answer: No, the applicant must not be a government employee, an employee of autonomous bodies or corporations, or a pensioner from any organization.

faqs.question: Is it mandatory for the applicant to be solely dependent on art-related activities and programmes to qualify for assistance?
faqs.answer: Yes, the applicant must be solely dependent on art-related activities and programmes to be considered eligible for this financial assistance.

faqs.question: Can an artist working on a regular payroll basis in a private company or institution apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: No, the applicant must not be working in any private agency, company, or institution on a regular basis or be on a regular payroll.

faqs.question: What fields of art and culture are recognized for eligibility under the pandemic relief component of this scheme?
faqs.answer: Artists working in Music, Dance, Drama, Tiatr, Folk, Kirtan, Bhajan, Painting, Sculpture, Literature, Cantarists, Sahittik, Poets, Photographers, and traditional Handicraft are eligible.

faqs.question: Is there any requirement to submit a declaration or affidavit regarding income from all sources when applying for assistance?
faqs.answer: Yes, applicants must submit a self-signed affidavit or declaration on ₹50/- stamp paper in the prescribed format regarding their individual income from all sources per annum.

faqs.question: Are artists who are receiving any other pension or financial assistance from the Central or State Government eligible for this scheme?
faqs.answer: No, artists receiving any other pension or financial assistance from either the Central Government or State Government are not eligible for this scheme.

faqs.question: What is the residency requirement for artists applying for pandemic-related financial assistance under this scheme?
faqs.answer: The applicant artist must be a resident of Goa to be eligible for financial assistance under the pandemic relief provision.

faqs.question: How does the committee determine the exact quantum of financial assistance to be sanctioned to each eligible artist?
faqs.answer: The committee will decide the quantum of assistance to be sanctioned within the prescribed limit of ₹5,000/- to ₹10,000/- based on their assessment.

faqs.question: In what mode will the financial assistance amount be disbursed to the eligible artist under the pandemic relief category?
faqs.answer: The financial assistance will be released directly into the bank account of the artist opened in a nationalized bank through Electronic Clearing System mode.

name: Pradhan Mantri Virasat ka Samvardhan
brief_description: PM VIKAS is a Central sector scheme that focuses on socio-economic empowerment of six notified minorities in the country through skilling & training, women leadership & empowerment and education. The scheme integrates erstwhile skilling & education schemes of the Ministry of Minority Affairs.
details:
The Pradhan Mantri Virasat Ka Samvardhan (PM VIKAS) is a Central Sector Scheme of the Ministry of Minority Affairs which converges five erstwhile schemes viz. ‘Seekho Aur Kamao’, ‘Nai Manzil’, ‘Nai Roshni’ and ‘USTTAD’ & ‘Hamari Dharohar’ schemes and focuses on socio-economic empowerment of six notified minority communities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, and Parsis) through the following:
i. Skilling and Training (Non-traditional and traditional)
ii. Women Leadership and Entrepreneurship
iii. Education (through National Institute of Open Schooling)
iv. Infrastructure Development (through Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram)
**Scheme Objectives**:
The initiative aims to empower minority communities through targeted skill training, formal education via open schooling, and improved livelihood opportunities. It promotes the preservation cultural heritage and traditional arts and crafts. Women from minority communities are empowered through leadership and entrepreneurship support. Market and credit linkages are provided to enhance employability and enterprise.
**Salient Features:**
1) Aims at holistic development of minority communities through skilling, education, entrepreneurship, and cultural heritage preservation. 
2) Merges five earlier schemes: Seekho aur Kamao, USTTAD, Hamari Dharohar, Nai Roshni, and Nai Manzil. 
3) Focuses on traditional and modern skill training, women’s leadership, education for school dropouts, and infrastructure development. 
4) Special emphasis on women, youth, and persons with disabilities from six notified minority communities. 
5) Provides financial support, market linkages, and credit access through convergence with other government schemes. 
6) 100% central funding for training, education, and entrepreneurship; infrastructure support via Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK) on a cost-sharing basis.
**Target Beneficiaries:**
1) Indian nationals belonging to the six notified minority communities: Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, and Parsis with following:
a. Minority individuals aged 14–45 years for skilling and education; 18–45 years for women leadership and entrepreneurship. 
b. Women beneficiaries: Minimum 33% in skilling, 50% in education, and 100% in women leadership and entrepreneurship component. 
c. Persons with Disabilities (PwDs): 3% reservation across all components. 
2) Up to 25% non-minority (EWS) candidates may be included in Traditional Skilling and 15% in other components to promote inter-community solidarity.
**Benefits:**
1) Provides skill development in both traditional crafts and modern sectors to enhance employability of minority youth. 
2) Empowers minority women through leadership and entrepreneurship training, including support to start enterprises. 
3) Offers bridge education for school dropouts to complete classes 8th, 10th, and 12th via open schooling. 
4) Facilitates access to credit, market linkages, and e-commerce platforms for artisans and entrepreneurs. 
5) Promotes preservation and promotion of traditional arts, crafts, and cultural heritage. 
6) Ensures inclusive development by converging with other government schemes and leveraging existing infrastructure.
benefits:
1) Skill training (both traditional and modern).
2) Education support (8th std, 10th std. and 12th std.).
3) Leadership and entrepreneurship support for women.
4) Stipend support to trainees.
eligibility:
- The Age of the applicant should be 14 to 45 years for skilling and education component and 18 to 45 years for Women Leadership and Entrepreneurship Component
 - 33% of total seats in Skilling and Training component, 50% of total seats in Education component and 100% of total seats in Women Leadership and Entrepreneurship component are earmarked for women. 
 - The education qualification for Skilling and Training component would be as per NSQF norms and Education component would be as per NIOS norms. Candidates with aptitude and leadership qualities will be selected for Women Leadership and Entrepreneurship component.

application_process.steps:
**Step 1:** **Register/Login**

 - Visit the [SIDH Portal](https://www.skillindiadigital.gov.in/home), register as a Learner/Participant (Candidate) or log in if already registered, and complete e-KYC using your personal details.
**Step 02: Profile Setup**

 - Create your account password/PIN, verify your mobile number via OTP, and ensure all profile details (name, date of birth, and contact information) are accurate and updated.

**Step 03: Explore Schemes & Courses**

 - Access your dashboard and search for PM VIKAS and job roles. Use filters such as scheme, mode, and sector to find suitable courses or batches.

**Step 04: Show Interest / Apply for a Batch**

 - Choose a batch for your preferred job role and submit your interest or application. You may select up to five batches, which will be reviewed by the training partner /training centre.

**Step 05**: **Finalise Enrolment & Status**

 - After approval from the training partner/training centre, accept the invitation through your portal to confirm enrolment. Track your application status under the “Applications” section.

documents_required: Aadhaar card and aadhar linked bank account.
Educational Qualification in line with the training programme being applied for.

faqs.question: What are the components supported under the scheme?
faqs.answer:
i. Skilling and Training (Non-traditional and traditional)

ii. Women Leadership and Entrepreneurship

iii. Education (through National Institute of Open Schooling)

iv. Infrastructure Development (through Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram)

faqs.question: What are the skills taught under the scheme?
faqs.answer: Any of the skills approved by the NSQC and registered under the National Qualification Register (NQR) are eligible to be provided under the scheme.

faqs.question: Is there any stipend provided under the scheme?
faqs.answer:
Yes. 

Rs.3000/- per month for beneficiaries undertaking traditional skilling, 
Rs. 2000/- per month for beneficiaries undertaking non-traditional (modern) skilling in non residential mode,
Rs. 1000/- per month for beneficiaries undertaking non-traditional (modern) skilling in residential mode (Max 12 months) 
Rs. 1000/- for beneficiaries enrolled under education component (Max 6 months), 
Rs. 200/- per day for beneficiaries under women leadership and entrepreneurship component

faqs.question: Does the scheme involves linking trained and certified candidates in modern skilling with placement opportunities?
faqs.answer: Placement of minimum 75% of beneficiaries trained under modern skilling are to be ensured by the implementing agency post completion of training program, with at least 50% of them in organised as categorized in the National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF)/ Common Cost Norms (CCN) of Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.

faqs.question: Who are eligible for benefiting under the scheme?
faqs.answer: Six notified communities under the NCM Act, i.e., Buddhists, Christian, Jains, Muslims, Parsis and Sikhs are eligible for applying under the scheme. However, up to 25% of seats may be earmarked under traditional skilling and up to 15% under other components for non minority EWS category.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required under the scheme?
faqs.answer: The educational qualification for Skilling and Training component would be as per National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF) norms and Education component would be as per National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS) norms. Candidates with aptitude and leadership qualities will be selected for Women Leadership and Entrepreneurship component.

faqs.question: Are there any seats earmarked for women candidates?
faqs.answer: 33% in Skilling and Training component, 50% in Education component and 100% in Women Leadership and Entrepreneurship component are reserved for women candidates.

faqs.question: Are there any seats earmarked for PwD candidates?
faqs.answer: 3% of the scheme benefits are earmarked for PwD candidates.

faqs.question: Is there any income criteria?
faqs.answer: Up to 25% of seats may be earmarked under traditional skilling and up to 15% under other components for non minority EWS category.

faqs.question: How to register for PM VIKAS scheme?
faqs.answer: Visit the SIDH Portal (https://www.skillindiadigital.gov.in/), register as a Learner/Participant (Candidate) or log in if already registered, and complete e-KYC using your personal details

faqs.question: How to apply for scheme/courses?
faqs.answer: Access your dashboard on SIDH portal to find PM VIKAS scheme and job roles. Use filters such as scheme, mode, and sector to find suitable courses or batches.

faqs.question: How to apply for a training batch?
faqs.answer: Choose a batch for your preferred job role and submit your interest or application. You may select up to five batches, which will be reviewed by the training partner /training centre.

faqs.question: How to finalize enrolment?
faqs.answer: After approval from the training partner / training centre, accept the invitation through your portal to confirm enrolment. Track your application status under the 'Applications' section.

name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Financial Assistance For Funeral of the Artist
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide financial relief to the families of deceased Goan artists by assisting them in meeting funeral expenses, thereby acknowledging the contributions of artists and supporting their families during difficult times. The component provides financial assistance of up to ₹10,000/-.
details: The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi" was launched by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. The "Financial Assistance for Funeral of the Artist" component of the scheme aims to provide financial relief to the families of deceased Goan artists by assisting them in meeting funeral expenses, thereby acknowledging the contributions of artists and supporting their families during difficult times. The component provides financial assistance of up to ₹10,000/- to cover expenses related to the funeral of a recognized Goan artist. The applicant must be a family member of the deceased artist. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.
benefits:
- Financial assistance of up to a maximum of ₹10,000/- shall be sanctioned to meet expenses in connection with the funeral of the Goan artist.
- The benefit is provided as a one-time lump sum grant.
- The financial assistance amount shall be disbursed to the eligible member of artist's family in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a family member of the deceased artist.
- The deceased artist must have been born and brought up in Goa.
- The deceased artist must have been recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa.
- The family income of the deceased artist (from all sources) must not exceed ₹2,00,000/- per annum.
- The applicant must not have claimed or received funeral assistance benefits from any other government source for the same purpose.

application_process.steps:
**Step 1:** Visit the office of the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa, and collect the prescribed application form for the scheme.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the completed application form along with all required documents directly to the ***Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa.***

##### ***Post-Application Processes***
**Step 1:** The Directorate shall forward the application to the sub-committee for scrutinizing the application thoroughly. The Director shall give its recommendations to the sub-committee.
**Step 2:** The sub-committee shall consider the received applications and recommend the names which are considered fit by the sub-committee to avail the benefits under this scheme. The committee shall decide the quantum of assistance to be released.
**Step 3:** After the committee decides on the quantum of assistance, the approval from the Government shall be obtained for disbursement of the financial assistance.
**Step 4:** After obtaining Government approval, the Director shall disburse the one-time financial assistance amount to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode to the bank account.

documents_required: Document establishing the family relation of the applicant with the deceased artist.
Recognition Certificate of the Artist (by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa)
_*All documents must be submitted in physical format as the application process is offline._
_*Documents issued by competent authorities must be attested copies._
_*Income certificate must be issued by the authorized revenue authority._

faqs.question: What is the maximum monetary benefit that can be granted to help cover the expenses incurred during the last rites and funeral ceremonies of a departed artist?
faqs.answer: The maximum financial assistance that can be sanctioned under this component is ₹10,000/- to meet expenses in connection with the funeral of the Goan artist.

faqs.question: Is there a specific time limit within which I must submit the death certificate after receiving approval for the funeral assistance under this component?
faqs.answer: Yes, you must furnish a copy of the death certificate within 2 months from the date of sanction of the financial assistance. This is a mandatory requirement for the benefit.

faqs.question: Will the financial aid be transferred directly to my bank account, or do I need to collect it physically from any government office?
faqs.answer: The financial assistance amount will be disbursed directly to your bank account through Electronic Clearing System mode after all approvals and documentation are completed.

faqs.question: Can I apply for this benefit if the deceased artist was receiving monthly pension under the Kala Samman scheme from the Art and Culture Department?
faqs.answer: No, the scheme explicitly states that it will not be applicable to beneficiaries of Kala Samman who receive monthly pensions from the Department of Art & Culture, Government of Goa.

faqs.question: Where exactly should I go to collect the application form and submit my request for financial assistance for funeral expenses of the artist?
faqs.answer: You should visit the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa during working days to collect the form and submit your completed application.

name: Ashramshalas (Grant in Aid)
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide schooling, boarding and lodging to Scheduled Tribe students at a single location, enabling better employment opportunities and competitive equality with other sections of society. The scheme offers residential education with complete support including free education.
details: The scheme "Ashramshalas (Grant in Aid)" was launched by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide comprehensive educational support to Scheduled Tribe students who cannot afford education due to weak economic conditions, addressing the issue of children being forced into traditional occupations or other jobs to support their families instead of attending school. The scheme provides residential schooling facilities with complete boarding and lodging arrangements, where tribal students receive free education, hostel facilities, books, food, and items of daily necessity through 100% grant-in-aid to Non-Governmental Organizations operating these schools across standards 1st to 12th.
benefits:
##### ***Financial Grant to Ashramshalas***
A grant of ₹1,500/- per month is provided to the Ashramshala for every enrolled child to cover all expenses related to education, boarding, and lodging.
_*The grant is provided on a monthly basis to the Ashramshalas for continuous support of enrolled students._
##### ***Benefits Provided to Students***

- Free education without any tuition fees.
- Free hostel facilities and accommodation.
- Free books and educational materials.
- Free food and meals.
- Items of daily necessity free of cost.

_*All benefits (education, boarding, lodging, food, books, and daily necessities) are provided continuously throughout the academic year._
##### ***Conditions***

- The Ashramshala must maintain the minimum enrollment requirements as specified in the eligibility criteria.
- The Ashramshala must continue to provide all stipulated facilities (education, boarding, lodging, food, books, and daily necessities) to the enrolled students.
- The Ashramshala must comply with all regulations and guidelines set by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat.
eligibility:
##### ***For Ashramshalas (Educational Institutions)***

- The Ashramshala must enrol a minimum of 15 boys and 15 girls for the first time on inception.
- The Ashramshala must enrol a minimum of 10 boys and 10 girls every year till 7th standard after the inception year.
- The Ashramshala must be operated by a Non-Governmental Organization working in tribal areas.
- The Ashramshala must be located within any district of Gujarat.
- The Ashramshala must provide education for standards 1st to 8th (Ashramshala), standards 9th to 10th (Uttar Buniyadi Ashramshala), or standards 11th to 12th (Uchchattar Uttar Buniyadi Ashramshala).

##### ***For Students (Beneficiaries)***

- The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe category.
- The applicant must be seeking admission to an Ashramshala for education from standard 1st to standard 12th.

application_process.steps:
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://tribal.gujarat.gov.in/application-forms) of the application form. Alternatively, the interested applicant may visit the Tribal Development Department, Govt. of Gujarat, and request the hard copy of the [prescribed format](https://tribal.gujarat.gov.in/application-forms) of the application form from the designated staff.

**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Prepare a detailed proposal outlining your organization's capabilities, infrastructure facilities, proposed location, staff arrangements, and plan for providing education, boarding, and lodging to Scheduled Tribe students. Submit the completed application form along with the comprehensive proposal and all supporting documents to the Tribal Development Department.

> ***Inspection and Approval***

- The Tribal Development Department will conduct an inspection of the proposed Ashramshala premises to verify the infrastructure, facilities, and readiness to operate the residential school. Cooperate fully during the inspection and provide any additional information or clarification requested by the inspection team. 
- Upon successful verification and approval, the Tribal Development Department will issue a formal sanction letter approving the grant-in-aid with terms and conditions, grant amount of ₹1,500/- per month per student, and guidelines for operation.

documents_required: Registration Certificate of the Non-Governmental Organization.
Recognition Certificate from the Education Department or Appropriate Authority.
List of Enrolled Students with Complete Details (including names, gender, standard, and Scheduled Tribe certificate numbers).
Bank Account Details of the Non-Governmental Organization (for direct benefit transfer of grant amounts).
Infrastructure Details and Facilities Available (hostel capacity, classrooms, kitchen facilities, etc.).
Staff Details (teachers, wardens, support staff with qualifications and appointments).
Utilization Certificate of Previous Grant (if applicable, for renewal or continuation of grant).

faqs.question: What are the minimum enrollment requirements that a residential school must fulfill during its inception year to qualify for government grant support?
faqs.answer: The residential school must enrol a minimum of 15 boys and 15 girls for the first time on inception to qualify for grant-in-aid support.

faqs.question: If my child belongs to the Scheduled Tribe category and needs educational support, can they receive free accommodation along with their studies?
faqs.answer: Yes, Scheduled Tribe students receive free hostel facilities and accommodation along with free education, food, books, and items of daily necessity.

faqs.question: What is the monthly financial grant amount provided to the residential school for each enrolled Scheduled Tribe student under this educational support program?
faqs.answer: A grant of ₹1,500/- per month is provided to the residential school for every enrolled Scheduled Tribe child to cover all educational and accommodation expenses.

faqs.question: After the first year of operation, how many male and female students must the residential school admit annually until the seventh standard?
faqs.answer: The residential school must enrol a minimum of 10 boys and 10 girls every year till 7th standard after the inception year.

faqs.question: Which categories of students are specifically targeted as the primary beneficiaries for admission to these government-supported residential educational institutions?
faqs.answer: Scheduled Tribe students are the primary beneficiaries and intended recipients of admission to these government-supported residential educational institutions.

faqs.question: Are there any tuition fees or charges that parents need to pay for their children's education in these residential schools?
faqs.answer: No, students receive completely free education without any tuition fees, along with free boarding, lodging, food, books, and daily necessities.

faqs.question: What type of organizations are permitted to operate these residential schools and receive grant-in-aid from the state government for tribal education?
faqs.answer: Non-Governmental Organizations working in tribal areas are permitted to operate these residential schools and receive 100% grant-in-aid from the state government.

faqs.question: In which year was this residential educational support program for tribal communities originally launched by the Tribal Development Department?
faqs.answer: This residential educational support program for tribal communities was originally launched in the year 1953 by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat.

faqs.question: What is the geographical coverage area where these grant-aided residential schools for tribal students are currently operational and accepting admissions?
faqs.answer: These grant-aided residential schools for tribal students are operational and accepting admissions across all districts of Gujarat.

faqs.question: What range of educational standards or classes are covered under the different types of residential schools supported through this grant program?
faqs.answer: The residential schools cover standards 1st to 8th (Ashramshala), standards 9 to 10 (Uttar Buniyadi Ashramshala), and standards 11th to 12th (Uchchattar Uttar Buniyadi Ashramshala).

faqs.question: Besides education and accommodation, what other essential items and facilities are provided free of cost to students in these residential institutions?
faqs.answer: Besides education and accommodation, students receive free books, food and meals, and items of daily necessity completely free of cost.

faqs.question: What was the primary objective behind establishing these residential educational institutions for children from tribal communities across the state?
faqs.answer: The primary objective is to provide schooling, boarding and lodging at a single location so that tribal students can get better employment and compete equally with other sections of society.

faqs.question: Where should interested parties contact for information and assistance regarding admission procedures or grant applications for these residential schools?
faqs.answer: Interested parties should contact the Tribal Development Department at 6th Floor, Block 8, New Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar, Gujarat 382010, or telephone number +91 79 23257703.

faqs.question: What economic circumstances necessitated the government to establish these fully funded residential schools specifically for tribal population children?
faqs.answer: The Scheduled Tribe population cannot afford to spend on their children's education due to weak economic conditions, forcing children into traditional occupations instead of schools.

name: Financial Assistance for Marriage of Poor Scheduled Caste Brides
brief_description: The scheme “Financial Assistance for Marriage of Poor Scheduled Caste Brides” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Govt of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to poor parents from Scheduled Castes for performing the marriage of their daughters.
details: The scheme “Financial Assistance for Marriage of Poor Scheduled Caste Brides” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Department, Government of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to poor parents from Scheduled Castes for performing the marriage of their daughters. The financial assistance is given at the rate of ₹15,000/- in each case for the marriage of their two daughters.
benefits: Financial Assistance of ₹15,000/- in each case for the marriage of their two daughters.
eligibility:
- The Parent/Guardian of the bride should be a citizen of India.
- The Parent/Guardian of the bride should be from a Scheduled Caste.
- The Parent/Guardian of the bride should be a native of Puducherry.
- The assistance is provided for the first marriage alone.
- The marriage should be registered.
- The assistance is available only for two daughters in a family.
- The application should be submitted 30 days prior to the date of marriage.
- The annual income of the parent/guardian should not exceed ₹2,00,000.
- The applicant should not be receiving financial assistance from other sources.
- The marriage should be performed in accordance with the law.
- The bride should have attained the age of 18 years.
- The bridegroom should have attained the age of 21 years.

application_process.steps:
**Step 1:** Visit the [Official Website](https://edistrict.py.gov.in/) of the e-District Portal of the Government of Puducherry.
**Step 2:** At the top right corner of the home page, click "[Login](https://edistrict.py.gov.in/Login.aspx)". In the login screen, click "[Register a New Membership](https://edistrict.py.gov.in/User/Registration.aspx)".
**Step 3:** On the Registration Page, fill in all the mandatory fields: Username, Password, Confirm Password, Personal Details (Full Name, First Name, Email Address, Address, Current Address, Gender, Date of Birth, Mobile Number). Agree to the declaration. Fill in the Captcha Code, and click "Signup".
**Step 4:** Visit the [Official Website](https://edistrict.py.gov.in/) of the e-District Portal of the Government of Puducherry.
**Step 5:** At the top right corner of the home page, click "[Login](https://edistrict.py.gov.in/Login.aspx)". In the login screen, provide your Username and Password, fill in the Captcha Code, and click "Sign In".
**Step 6:** On the next screen, a list of schemes by the Government of Puducherry will be displayed Department-wise.
**Step 7:** Click on the scheme you wish to apply for. You will be taken to its online application form.
**Step 8:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields (marked with a red asterisk) and upload all the mandatory documents (self-attest if required). 
**Step 9:** Tick the declaration stating "I hereby declare that the above-mentioned details are true and correct as per the best of my Knowledge". Submit the application and note the application number for [tracking your application](https://edistrict.py.gov.in/User/TrackApplication.aspx). The application number will also be received on your Registered Mobile Number / Registered Email ID.
***Track Your Application** [here](https://edistrict.py.gov.in/User/TrackApplication.aspx)
*** Access the User Manual for Online Application** [here](https://edistrict.py.gov.in/Help.rar)

documents_required: Birth Certificate or TC of the Bride.
Birth Certificate or TC of the Bridegroom.
Recent passport-size photograph of the Bride.
Recent passport-size photograph of the Bridegroom.
First-time Marriage Certificate obtained from MP/MLA/Commissioner of Municipality/Commune Panchayat.
Bank Account details of the applicant.

faqs.question: Is there a specific authority from which the first-time marriage certificate should be obtained?
faqs.answer: The first-time marriage certificate should be obtained from MP/MLA/Commissioner of Municipality/Commune Panchayat as specified in the scheme guidelines.

faqs.question: Are there any restrictions on the source of financial assistance for the applicant?
faqs.answer: Applicants should not be receiving financial assistance from other sources to be eligible for this scheme.

faqs.question: Can the financial assistance be availed for subsequent marriages?
faqs.answer: No, the assistance is provided for the first marriage only, as per the guidelines of the scheme.

faqs.question: When should the application for financial assistance be submitted?
faqs.answer: The application must be submitted 30 days prior to the scheduled date of marriage to be considered for financial assistance.

faqs.question: Is there an age requirement for the bride and groom to qualify for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes, the bride should be at least 18 years old, and the groom should be at least 21 years old at the time of marriage.

faqs.question: How many daughters per family are eligible for financial assistance under this scheme?
faqs.answer: Financial assistance is available for the marriage of the first two daughters in a family, provided they meet the eligibility criteria.

faqs.question: Is There Any Application Fee?
faqs.answer: No, applicants can rest assured that the entire application process is entirely free of cost. There are no fees associated with applying for this scheme.

faqs.question: Is There Any Compensation For The Delay In The Disbursal Of The Scheme Benefits?
faqs.answer: The guidelines do not mention any provision for compensation in the event of delayed disbursement of scheme benefits. Applicants should note that compensation for delays is not part of the scheme's framework.

faqs.question: Can Applicants From The Neighboring States/UTs Also Apply To This Scheme?
faqs.answer: Unfortunately, this scheme is exclusively available to permanent residents of the Puducherry. Applicants from neighboring States/UTs, among others, are not eligible to apply.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban
brief_description: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U) Scheme was launched on 25th June 2015 by the Hon’ble Prime Minister to provide all-weather pucca houses to all eligible urban households across the nation with the vision of ‘Housing for All’.
details: The “Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U)” was launched on 25th June 2015 by the Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs, Government of India with the vision of “Housing for All” to provide pucca houses to eligible urban households. Implemented by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, the scheme addresses urban housing shortages, especially for EWS, LIG, and MIG categories, including slum dwellers. It promotes affordable and sustainable housing through components like the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS), offering interest subsidies on housing loans. The mission covers all statutory towns and notified urban areas as per Census 2011. Aadhaar is mandatory for all eligible beneficiaries under the scheme.
benefits: **States/UTs****BLC & AHP****ARH****ISS**Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Meghalaya, Manipur, Mizoram, Nagaland, Tripura, Sikkim, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, UTs of Jammu and Kashmir, Puducherry, and DelhiCentral Govt. - ₹2.25 lakh/Unit; State Govt. - Min. ₹0.25 lakh/UnitTechnology Innovation Grant Central Govt. - ₹3,000/sqm per unit State Govt.- ₹2,000/sqm per unit Home Loan Subsidy – up to ₹1.80 lakh (Actual Release) per unit by the Government of India as a Central Sector SchemeAll other UTsCentral Govt. - ₹2.50 lakh/UnitDoDoAll other StatesCentral Govt. - ₹1.5 lakh/Unit; State Govt. - Min. ₹1.00 lakh/UnitDoDo
eligibility:
1. The family identifies as one of the following -
a) Economically Weaker Section (EWS): households with annual income up to ₹3,00,000.
b) Low Income Group (LIG): households with annual income between ₹3,00,001 and ₹6,00,000.
c) Middle Income Group-1 (MIG-1): households with annual income between ₹6,00,001 and ₹12,00,000.
d) Middle Income Group-2 (MIG-2): households with annual income between ₹12,00,001 and ₹18,00,000.
2. The applicant or his/her family members must not own a pucca house in any part of the country.
3. The family must comprise of husband/wife and unmarried children.
4. The town/city in which the family resides must be covered under the scheme.
5. The family MUST NOT have previously availed the benefits of any housing-related schemes set up by the Government of India.

application_process.steps:
**Step 1:** Interested beneficiary who wants to own a house under PMAY-U 2.0 can register herself/himself on the [PMAY-U 2.0 website](https://pmay-urban.gov.in/), wherein it is required to click on ‘Apply for PMAY-U 2.0’ tab. 
**Step 2:** The User is required to read and understand the instructions carefully, her/his eligibility criteria, the option to choose any one vertical out of the four verticals of PMAY-U 2,0 before availing the benefits.
**Step 3:** After proceeding, the User needs to undergo the eligibility check for the scheme.
**Step 4:** Once the Eligibility check is completed, the user shall give consent for Aadhaar authentication. 
**Step 5:** User will then be taken to the Beneficiary Survey Form for all verticals. The survey form has different sections.
> User Manual: [Click here](https://pmaymis.gov.in/PMAYMIS2_2024/PDF/UserManual/BeneficairyApplication_for_SoP_27_12_24.pdf).

**Step 1:** Visit a [Common Service Centre (CSC) near you](https://cscindia.info/). 
**Step 2:** Purchase the application form by paying ₹ 25 (plus GST) at the counter.
**Step 3:** In the form, fill in all the mandatory details, and attach copies of the required documents. The details to be filled include name, contact number, other personal details, bank account and income details, among others.
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form at the CSC.

documents_required: Aadhaar Number (or Aadhaar/ Aadhaar Enrolment ID)
Self-Certificate / Affidavit as Proof of Income.
Identity and Residential Proof (PAN card, Voter ID, Driving License)
Proof of Minority Community (if the applicant belongs to a Minority Community)
EWS Certificate / LIG Certificate / MIG Certificate (as applicable)
Affidavit / Proof that the applicant does not own a ‘pucca’ house
Affidavit / Proof that the applicant is constructing a home under the scheme

faqs.question: Is the entire mission implemented as Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS)?
faqs.answer: Except for the component of Credit Linked Subsidy which is implemented as a Central Sector Scheme, the rest of the mission is implemented as Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS).

faqs.question: I need to know the technical specifications, construction standards of the houses/slums that will be built under this scheme?
faqs.answer: The houses must conform to the standards provided in National Building Code (NBC) and Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS). For a detailed description of the houses/slums, please refer Section-2 of the scheme guidelines: https://pmay-urban.gov.in/uploads/guidelines/60180813309f2-Updated%20guidelines%20of%20PMAY-U.pdf

faqs.question: Are there any sections that would be given preference while providing the benefits?
faqs.answer: Preference will be given to differently-abled persons, senior citizens, SCs, STs, OBCs, Minority, single women, transgender and other weaker & vulnerable sections of the society.

faqs.question: Will I still be eligible to apply for government’s ongoing or upcoming schemes if I apply for PMAY-U?
faqs.answer: The benefits of all existing and future rural schemes will not be denied to a beneficiary solely on the grounds that she/he has availed a house under PMAY(U).

faqs.question: I am a beneficiary of PMAY (G) but I am in the permanent waitlist. What are my options?
faqs.answer: The beneficiaries in the permanent wait list of PMAY (G) will have the flexibility for opting for a house under PMAY(G) or PMAY(U).

faqs.question: How do I know if my town is covered under the scheme?
faqs.answer: You can visit https://pmay-urban.gov.in/pmayprogress to check the same. Alternatively, you can visit https://pmay-urban.gov.in/ and head to "City Wise Progress".

faqs.question: For how am I required to be residing in an urban area to become a beneficiary under this scheme?
faqs.answer: The States/UTs, at their discretion, may decide a cut-off date on which beneficiaries need to be a resident of that urban area for being eligible to take benefits under the scheme.

faqs.question: Will central assistance be provided for rehabilitation of dwellers from slums built on private land?
faqs.answer: No, slums built on private land are not covered under central assistance.

faqs.question: Is there a private entity authorised by MoHUA to collect fee from the beneficiary under PMAY-U?
faqs.answer: No private entity/persons have been authorised by MoHUA to collect this fee from any beneficiary under this scheme.

faqs.question: How do I know if a field in the application form is mandatory?
faqs.answer: The mandatory fields have a red asterisk (*) mark at the end.

faqs.question: How do I check my application status?
faqs.answer:
There are two ways in which the applicant can check his/her application status:
Method-1: Using Assessment ID.
Step 1: Log on to the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana website: http://pmaymis.gov.in/Track_Application_Status.aspx or go to the 'Citizen Application' option and then choose the 'Check Status' button.
Step 2: When you hit the track button, there will be two options displayed: 'By Name, Father's Name & Mobile No' and 'By Assessment ID'.
Step 3: Choose the 'By Assessment ID' option.
Step 4: Enter the Assessment ID & Mobile Number that was assigned when the form was filled and submitted.
Step 5: After filling in the details, click 'Submit'.
